categories.title: Boutique
categories.info: Boutiques are stores that specialize entirely in wardrobe clothing items. Once you've purchased everything in their stock, the map icon will be marked with a tick.

categories.title: Catapult Seal
categories.info:
Need a boost? Use the powerful bouncing tails of seal Whimborn to launch Nikki up, up, and away!

Speak to the NPC nearby to feed the seal. When its tail glows, the seal is ready to launch Nikki.

categories.title: General Store
categories.info: General Stores sell any non-clothing item, usually within a specific theme of crafting materials. Unlike Boutiques, their map icons aren't marked with a tick even after you buy everything.

categories.title: Gliding Station
categories.info: After unlocking the Floral Memory Outfit, Nikki can use Skypass routes to glide across great distances.
categories.template: _??'s Gliding Station. After the station manager activates the Stoneheart, a Skypass from ?? to ?? can be opened. Have fun gliding!_

categories.title: House
categories.info: Houses are non-hostile buildings that you can enter and interact with NPCs inside.

categories.title: Sky Monarch
categories.info: Groom the Sky Monarch when it lands here at its nest to be able ride on its back. This will often allow you to reach very high Whimstars.

categories.title: Stray Hatty
categories.info: Stray Hatty has been stranded in Florawish with only their Master's Whim energy to spare. Trade increasing amounts of Blings in exchange for Stray Hatty's Whimstars.

categories.title: Surprise-O-Matic
categories.info: Spend Blings at this clothing vending machine for a chance at some rare wardrobe pieces!
categories.template: _A clothing vending machine created by the Whale Consortium. Rumble, rumble... the surprise ball is rolling, and your heart is racing!_

categories.title: Warp Spire
categories.info: Activate Warp Spires to unlock fast travel and respawn points across Miraland. You can fast travel by selecting a spire from the map screen. Each one discovered gives 20x Diamonds.

categories.title: Box Game
categories.info:
Test Nikki's skills with Wishfield's regional box games popular among local townspeople. After completing a collection, speak to [Ciceto](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421553) in Florawish for additional rewards.

**Rewards:**
- Diamond x10
- Bling x12K

categories.title: Curio Domain
categories.info: Enter Curio gateways to complete skill challenges and earn Whimstars.

categories.title: Expedition Photo
categories.info:
After unlocking the camera, Nikki can embark on Expedition Quests. Like other photo quests, these require you to take photos of specific subjects or locations. Make sure to upload photos to the Expedition Journal for them to count!

**Reward:** Upgrade Pack x3

categories.title: Mini Game
categories.info: Test your skills with obstacle courses throughout Miraland! Each mini-game attempt costs 100 Blings. Your first Clear awards 10 Diamonds, and your first Perfect Clear awards 30 more Diamonds.

categories.title: Power Box
categories.info:
Explore Miraland at night to see broken, sparking streetlamps that can be repaired with an Electrician ability outfit.

**Rewards:**
- 30 x Diamonds
- 10,000 Blings

categories.title: Styling Challenge
categories.info: Styling Challenges are essentially the "boss battles" of fashion in Miraland. Rise through the faction ranks until Nikki reaches can challenge the regional Sovereign.

categories.title: Dew of Inspiration
categories.info: Dews can be given to [Kilo the Candenceborn](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419501) in Florawish and [Ian the Cadenceborn](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507251) in Itzaland in exchange for resources, Mira EXP, exclusive Sketches and music Records. To collect these, hit them with a purification attack.

categories.title: Lore Item
categories.info: Books and other documents that expand on the lore of Infinity Nikki. These are logged in the Pearpal's Lore section of the Compendium.

categories.title: Record
categories.info: Records can be played on Gramophones at Nikki's House to play pieces of the game's soundtrack instead of the normal Nikki's House music.

categories.title: Whimstar
categories.info: Whimstars are the major collectible in Wishfield, and are used to purchase unlocked nodes in the Hearts of Infinity.

categories.title: Bling Esseling
categories.info: An Esseling that A unique Esseling that erupts into 3K Blings after being defeated, and respawns daily at designated locations. Florawish's Greedy Pouches will try to run away, while Itzaland's Flit-Flits will stand and fight.

categories.title: Exclusive Quest
categories.info: Exclusive Quests are the longest kind of side quests, often involving a lengthy quest chain. Story quests tied to new updates will use Exclusive Quests in lieu of Main Quests.

categories.title: Main Quest
categories.info: Main Quests comprise the main story of Infinity Nikki regarding the Miracle Outfits and coma incidents. They unlock new areas, features and Ability Outfits.

categories.title: Random Quest
categories.info: Random Quests are short side quests that can usually be completed in the area where you started them.

categories.title: World Quest
categories.info: World Quests are side quests that, as the name implies, tend to send Nikki all across the map the quest is given in.

locations.title: Nonoy's House
locations.description: _Where Nonoy and her family reside. A cozy home enveloped in greenery, where every decoration tells memories worth reminiscing._

locations.title: Daisy Inn
locations.description: _For travelers, it's a home away from home, always greeting guests with exceptional service._

locations.title: Ray and Wing's
locations.description: _A local restaurant with over 100 years of history, telling the story of Florawish through its favors. Each clink of bowls and plates is a note in its grand culinary symphony!_

locations.title: Bibcoon's Chuckle Club
locations.description: _A club that's alive with laughter. Behind its mysterious door on the street corner lies an enchanting evening of wonder and relaxation._

locations.title: Mayor's Residence
locations.description: _The Mayor's residence in Florawish where the eternal torch ob ambition never dims--even on the darkest of nights._

locations.title: Kingdom Guards' Office
locations.description: _Guardians of Florawish's peace and serenity. Their dedicated actions embody beliefs and duty, earning the townsfolk's trust and respect._

locations.title: Sanctum of the Observant
locations.description: _A sanctum dedicated to the Society of Observers._

locations.title: Dye Workshop
locations.description: _The dye workshop passed down for centuries. From a broken house to a proper workshop, flowers are used to dye beautiful fabrics, and silk threads are woven into hopes for life here._

locations.title: Wish Auditing Station
locations.description: _Wishing Orbs come here for a final check with one goal in mind-ensuring no good wish is missed, and no bad wish gets through._

locations.title: Temple of Wishes
locations.description: _The memorial hall for Faewish Sprites. This place stores ancient history and bears witness to new stories._

locations.title: Cavern Prison
locations.description: _A cavern where the Wish Master's Paladins detain and punish Faewish Sprites._

locations.title: Desperation Orb Warehouse Cavern
locations.description: _A hidden site for the disposal of Desperation Orbs, all of which are closely guarded by the Paladins._

locations.title: Home of the Saintess
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 1F

_A home wrapped in the blessings and love of the Shroomlings, also a resting place for Nikki and Momo._

locations.title: Grace Dining Hall / Sugarbloom Isle
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 1F

_Spira's innovative boutique restaurant, where signature dishes combine flavors from multiple regions and delight guests with their unique appeal._

**NOTE:** To use this to enter Sugarbloom Isle, you must first complete "[Vow of the Returning Heartlight](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=545779)".

**Inside:**
- Whimstar x3
- Dew of Inspiration x17

locations.title: Docilist Church
locations.description: The church for the Docilists. While it's only visited once as part of the story, by the end you can freely enter this building.

locations.title: Society of Observers' Gathering Spot in Elderwood Forest

locations.description:

_The heart of the Parksolians' soul-ferrying system. Here, the Ferryman Guild uses the Soul Pendulum to continuously monitor the Soul Surge, analyzing and recording the unique ripples that emerge within it._

locations.title: The Soul Observatory Underground Chamber
locations.description: _A vast, silent chamber deep underground, built to study the Soulrift that afflicts the Parksolians. Once used to observe the surging flow of souls, it remains a place of both protection and inquiry._

locations.title: Surprise-O-Matic
locations.description: _A clothing vending machine created by the Whale Consortium. Rumble, rumble... the surprise ball is rolling, and your heart is racing!_

locations.title: Surprise-O-Matic
locations.description: _A clothing vending machine created by the Whale Consortium. Rumble, rumble... the surprise ball is rolling, and your heart is racing!_

locations.title: Cicia Art Academy Field Base
locations.description: _The Field Base for the Cicia Art Academy, where students find inspiration, create art, and exchange ideas._

locations.title: The Leisureely Anglers Florawish Branch
locations.description: _The Florawish branch of the Leisureely Anglers. Worries and problems are whisked away by the tranquil breeze of the lake, while joy can be found with the fish._

locations.title: By the Stylist's Guild Memorial
locations.description: _A bridge close to the Stylist's Guild Memorial. It has witnessed countless stylists embark on their journeys._

locations.title: Stylist's Guild Front Gate
locations.description: _For every stylist in Florawish, this is where their dreams begin._

locations.title: In Front of the Mayor's Residence
locations.description: _Listening and understanding are their guiding principles. This place is filled with kindness and compassion._

locations.title: Dream Warehouse Tower
locations.description: _The tower connected to the Dream Warehouse is filled with books. Within them lies the history of the town, where wishes have left their mark._

locations.title: Secret Base
locations.description: _A hidden corner of the world, away from the crowds--a haven for the soul._

locations.title: Florawish Lane
locations.description: _The entrance to Florawish. Cozy small-town life flourishes on the flower-scented streets._

locations.title: Meadow Activity Support Center
locations.description: _An agency established by the Florawish government to support all recreational activities, infusing them with the unique charm and joy of the meadow._

locations.title: Village Fork
locations.description: _Homes nestled within the Stonetrees, filled with laughter and the joy of harvest--an embodiment of life's sweetness._

locations.title: Lavenfringe Fields
locations.description: _The joy of harvesting Lavenfringes on sunny days; the beauty of the village is found in these flower fields._

locations.title: Cicchetto Manor
locations.description: _In a secluded corner of the village, the doors of ancient houses remain tightly shut, yet the tales of old continue to be passed down._

locations.title: Dye Workshop Stonetree
locations.description:
**Tier:** Dye Workshop Stonetree 3F

_The top of the Stonetree by the Dye Workshop. From above, you can see colorful fabrics fluttering in the breeze._

locations.title: Rockfall Valley
locations.description: _A valley reshaped by fallen rocks. Centuries have weathered the stones, concealing a once-flourishing past._

locations.title: Stoneville Entrance
locations.description: _A country pathway. The soft soils leads to a hidden village by the Stonetrees._

locations.title: Lakeside Hill Lane
locations.description: _Green grass, winding rivers, shady trees, and gentle breezes define the serene landscape. A quiet country path winds its way toward a seldom-trodden forest._

locations.title: Queen's Palace Ruins Entrance
locations.description: _The road to Queen Philomia's Palace Ruins. Once aglow with eternal lights, now stands empty and devoid of visitors._

locations.title: Queen's Palace Ruins Front Yard
locations.description: _The courtyard of Queen Philomia's Palace Ruins. Legends buried beneath the fallen stone columns continue to echo through the silent corridors._

locations.title: Heartcraft Kingdom Outpost
locations.description: _At the border of the Heartcraft Kingdom, a bridge once connected it to the Empire of Light. Now, the bridge lies in ruins, and only the Kingdom Guards remain, vigilant and steadfast._

locations.title: Abandoned Fanatic Wisher Camp
locations.description: _An abandoned encampment of the Fanatic Wishers. Only neglected barricades, shattered shields, and torn flags remain._

locations.title: Abandoned Fanatic Wisher Camp Outpost
locations.description: _An abandoned outpost of the Fanatic Wishers. The scent of gunpowder has long faded, and plants flourish in silence._

locations.title: Besides the Golden Fields
locations.description:
**Tier:** Golden Fields 2F

_The wheat fields of Prosperville. When the wind sweeps through, waves of green ripple across the land._

locations.title: Golden Fields Stonetree Top
locations.description:
**Tier:** Golden Fields 3F

_Time has worn away the rooftops and eroded the stone walls. The old farm is now reduced to crumbling ruins, but the longing for a bountiful harvest endures._

locations.title: Market of Mirth Entrance
locations.description:
**Tier:** Market of Mirth 1F

_Come on! Sunshine, dance, and Catapult Seals--though the tents may fade, the colorful joy never ends._

locations.title: Handsome Lads Circus
locations.description:
**Tier:** Market of Mirth 3F

_The Handsome Lads Circus. Enjoy Clown Nose Carson's exciting tales and performances, and leave your worries behind!_

locations.title: Market of Mirth Summit Path
locations.description:
**Tier:** Market of Mirth 2F

_The pathway leading to the grounds of the Market of Mirth. Bounce your way up, where happiness awaits at the top._

locations.title: Flamecrest Stonetree
locations.description:
**Tier:** Flamecrest Stonetree 3F

_The grounds for the Flamecrest Festival, where a grand bonfire burns. After the wishes are set aflame, people will continue on their own journeys._

locations.title: Well of Fortune
locations.description:
_A hidden area concealed behind a waterfalls, seemingly untouched for ages._

The Well of Fortune is underground, but can be reached by following the path leading north from [Nonoy's House](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=417466).

**Inside:**
- Whimstar x4
- Dew of Inspiration x25
- Record x5

locations.title: Dream Warehouse Rooftop
locations.description:
_The highest point of Florawish. Here, the town's past lies in rest, while its future unfolds before our eyes._

**Inside:**
- Whimstar x3  
- Dew of Inspiration x26
- Record x5
- Lore Item x3

locations.title: Relic Hill
locations.description: _A hill littered with ruins. Remnants of Old Florawish still remain, while the stars once reflected on the lake have all fallen._

locations.title: Beside the Ripple Wine Cellar
locations.description:
_Time quietly ferments, and the old vineyard lies abandoned, bearing the marks of time._

**Inside:**
- Whimstar x4
- Dew of Inspiration x21
- Record x5
- Lore Item x2

locations.title: Wish Pass Office
locations.description: _The only way to access the Wishing Woods. Pass the interview, and you'll get an invitation from the Faewish Sprite._

locations.title: In Front of the Sanctum of the Observant
locations.description: _Observers come and go, all seeking the mysteries of the world and the truth of styling._

locations.title: Beside the Statue in the Old Florawish Memorial
locations.description: _Established to commemorate Old Florawish, which was lost to disaster. The park is now a historical landmark._

locations.title: Meadow Wharf
locations.description: _A wharf dedicated solely to shipping goods from the Stoneville Dye Workshop to the rest of the world._

locations.title: Stitch Street
locations.description: _Here, one can view the comfy and warm small town and feel the lake's pulse and the forest's breeze, where life and nature meet._

locations.title: Bug Catcher's Cabin
locations.description: _The residence of insect researcher Kourtin, a gathering place for insect enthusiasts. Here, people engage closely with nature, where mysteries come alive amid the symphony of insect sounds._

locations.title: Gliding Training Stonetree
locations.description:
**Tier:** Gliding Training Stonetree 2F

_Every Wish Collector takes their first leap here._

locations.title: Queen's Palace Ruins High Tower
locations.description:
To get here, follow the Blings to climb up onto the roof..

_The high tower of Queen Philomia's Palace Ruins. From here, the quiet passage of countless years can be seen with striking clarity._

locations.title: Barrel Grove
locations.description:
**Tier:** Ripple Estate 2F

_A resting area for vineyard workers. A game in the shade is the perfect way to unwind._

locations.title: Barrel Home
locations.description:
**Tier:** Ripple Estate 3F

_A cottage made from old wooden barrels serves as the home for the Pieceys of Ripple Estate. Every night is filled with rich aromas._

locations.title: Choo-Choo Station Old Platform
locations.description: _The old platform at Choo-Choo Station. Vines and rust intertwine, marking the convergence of a journey's beginning and end._

locations.title: Choo-Choo Station Shipping Center
locations.description: _A place for storing and transporting train cargo. As trains come and go, some things are left behind, while others depart with the sound of a whistle._

locations.title: Choo-Choo Station Repair Station
locations.description:
**Tier:** Choo-Choo Station 2F

_A repair station for trains. Wrenches and screws clatter away as workers toil diligently, with no guarantees that they can fix what they're working on._

locations.title: Choo-Choo Station Stonetree Top
locations.description:
**Tier:** Choo-Choo Station 3F

_The remnants of an old station. Broken tracks, a silent platform, and a next stop forever out of reach._

locations.title: Prosperville Entrance
locations.description: _The road leading to Prosperville. Footprints fade with time, leaving only silence and shadows behind._

locations.title: Stone Steles
locations.description:
**Tier:** Prosperville 3F

_The grounds where the wishes and memories of the Forgotten are engraved in stone._

locations.title: Wishing Well
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 3F

_A wishing well built by the Pieceys. Though the Silvergale is now only found in stories and legends, they still wish for His guidance._

locations.title: Stonecrown Peak
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 4F

_The Silvergale's legendary resting place._

locations.title: Ghost Train Entrance
locations.description:
**Tier:** Choo-Choo Station 1F

_The tracks extend into a dark tunnel, and as the pulse quickens, a mechanism activates, propelling the train forward._

**Inside:**
- Whimstar x3
- Dew of Inspiration x23
- Record x5
- Lore Item x3

locations.title: Volunteer Corps Watchtower
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 2F

_Giant rocks form a spiraling staircase, and only by ascending watchtower after watchtower can one reach a fabled destination._

locations.title: Queen's Palace Ruins West Forest
locations.description: _The woods near Queen Philomia's Palace Ruins. The shadows of the dense forest shallow the past, while time leaves the silent woods watching over the abandoned relics._

locations.title: Golden Fields Old Dock
locations.description:
**Tier:** Golden Fields 1F

_The former dock of the Golden Fields. The dilapidated boardwalk is shrouded in mist, with no sounds of the once bustling dock remaining._

locations.title: Stellar Fishing Ground Trail
locations.description: _Every night, the lake shimmers with the glow of countless stars._

locations.title: Windrider Mill Mid-Level
locations.description:
**Tier:** Windrider Mill 2F

_The highlands where the Thuddy Squash grows. Radiant Thuddy Squash and leisurely Pieceys--this is the essence of good times._

locations.title: Windrider Mill Top
locations.description:
**Tier:** Windrider Mill 3F

_The old milling area, where the windmill still softly turns, releasing a warm aroma into the breeze._

locations.title: Windrider Mill Entrance
locations.description:
**Tier:** Windrider Mill 2F

_Golden flowers line the path, enclosed by a low stone wall, where grain was once gathered and transported in sacks brimming with golden joy._

locations.title: Elderwood Riverbank
locations.description: _A valley preserving ancient giant trees. The passing of time can be seen in the rings of each tree._

locations.title: In Front of the Wish Inspection Center
locations.description: _A place where wishes are sorted. The Faewish Sprites, cradling their Wishing Orbs, flit about busily, devoted to carefully listening to each and every wish._

locations.title: Wishcraft Lab
locations.description: _Here, the Faewish Sprite researchers turn sparks of inspiration into reality._

locations.title: Timis's Beauty Lab
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress "[Cleansing Oil Mission](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497644)"

_The beauty lab of Timis the Cosmetics Merchant, where whimsical dreams become reality, and magical beauty products are crafted._

**Contains:**
- Whimstar x3
- Dew of Inspiration x18

locations.title: Grand Tree Shoal
locations.description: _At the shoal beneath the Grand Millewish Tree, the stream wraps around its massive trunk, reflecting the glimmers of lights._

locations.title: Flower Valley Waterfall
locations.description: _Soft laughter lingers by the water's edge as the breeze carries the delicate fragrance of the Aurosa._

locations.title: Wish Celebration Center
locations.description: _A place for ceremonies, where colorful confetti and golden handwoven flowers celebrate the innocence of new life and the splendor of coming-of-age._

locations.title: Forgotten Village Dwelling
locations.description: _The prosperity of the past has faded, leaving only the forgotten to dwell here. Memories blur, bodies break, yet the act of mending continues._

locations.title: Beauty Lab's Waterwheel
locations.description: _The waterwheel powering the Beauty Lab is always in motion, never pausing._

locations.title: Farm Entrance
locations.description: _A farm rented by Timis. Paid with Blings and the latest beauty products, Faewish Sprites help harvest plants, process ingredients, and deliver them to the beauty lab._

locations.title: Bizarre Wish Hills
locations.description: _Hills formed from Bizarre Wishing Orbs, piled up over the years, with their disposal endlessly postponed for centuries to come._

locations.title: Grand Tree Residential Area
locations.description: _The home of the Faewish Sprites, a tiny world nestled among the intertwining branches and leaves, both charming and cozy._

locations.title: Temple of Wishes
locations.description: _The Wish Master's residence. A place that holds ancient history and bears witness to new stories._

locations.title: Garrison of the Paladins
locations.description: _The garrison of the Wish Master's Paladins. With unwavering will and honor, they hone their skills to protect their homeland and beliefs._

locations.title: Desperation Orb Warehouse
locations.description: _The Paladins' facility for recycling Desperation Orbs. Dark crimson in color, these orbs are vessels for danger and calamity, kept here to protect the world._

locations.title: Aurosa Valley
locations.description: _The sacred ground of the Faewish Sprites, where the legendary Aurosa blooms around the statue of The Wishing One, standing quietly in the wind._

locations.title: Land of Starfall
locations.description: _The final resting place for Faewish Sprites. Here, during the Farewish Ceremony, they become glimmers and return to The Wishing One._

locations.title: Ascetic Camp
locations.description: _A place of ascetic practices. Few Wishing Orbs and little rest are found here, as they practice daily to atone for their sins._

locations.title: Swordsmith Ruins Gate
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Progress "[Explore! The Swordsmith Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=499983)"

_Stone walls may shatter, copper and iron may rust, but courage and steadfastness never decay._

**Contains:**
- 5x Whimstar x5
- 16x Dews of Inspiration x16

locations.title: Ruins of the Guardians
locations.description: _The Iron Squirrel Statues stand hear. Time may wear things down, but the will to protect remains unshaken._

locations.title: Secluded Cave
locations.description: _Tucked away in the secluded forest and mountains, this dark cave hides unknown dangers._

locations.title: Stellar Fishing Ground Peak
locations.description: _A small pond surrounded by flowering trees, once home to legendary beings._

locations.title: Volunteer Corps Jail
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 3F

_The dark side of the Stonetree, a place always under strict surveillance. Imprisoned Faewish Sprites and Pieceys have no way to escape._

locations.title: Stonecrown Entrance
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 2F

_Here, beneath the tallest of Stonetrees, past legends fade from sight, yet the vow to protect remains ever steadfast._

locations.title: Thuddy Squash Workshop
locations.description: _Day in and day out, the workshop is bustling as they prepare everything from homes to tools for the rest of the Stonetree Cluster and the Volunteer Corps._

locations.title: Swordsmith Ruins Entrance
locations.description: _A broken stone path leads into the ancient ruins. The wind howls past, carrying distant whispers._

locations.title: Waterspout Observatory
locations.description: _Mysterious waterspouts, ever-changing and unpredictable. Staying observant and alert is key._

locations.title: Shoal Slope
locations.description: _On the moss-covered shoal where streams meet, Faewish Sprites occasionally pass by, heading toward the distant Grand Millewish Tree._

locations.title: Queen Philomia's Palace Ruins Underground Entrance
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete the [In the Lonely Song](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=456877) Exclusive Quest.

_The entrance of Queen Philomia's Palace leads to hidden underground secrets._

**Inside:**
- Whimstar x3  
- Dew of Inspiration x25
- Lore Item x2

locations.title: Serpentine Ruins
locations.description:
_The dwelling place of the Serpent. Within the cavern lies a sanctuary that never crumbles, shrouded in countless secrets._

**Inside:**
- Whimstar x4
- Dew of Inspiration x29
- Lore Item x1

locations.title: Itzaland Canyon East
locations.description: _Between the two steep cliffs lies a winding path. Pass through the valley and the vast Itzaland will present itself to you._

locations.title: Snail Clinic
locations.description: _Wide leaves spread like umbrellas. Here, the snails can receive the most proper care._

locations.title: Giant Spear Station
locations.description: _Rent a snail from the Shroomlings at the Giant Spear Station to climb up the spear and reach the city of Spira above._

locations.title: Grace Dining Hall
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 1F

_Diners gather here, delighting in new dishes whose flavors gently tug at their hearts._

locations.title: Whoosh-way Entrance
locations.description: _The Whoosh-way is a road built by the Shroomlings as a means of transport. Snails loaded with cargo can often be seen traversing its quiet paths._

locations.title: Shroomville
locations.description: _Treehouses stand at varying heights, sheltered by lush greenery. Here, the brave and cheerful Shroomlings make their homes, serving as steadfast support for one another._

locations.title: Mothershroom Woods
locations.description: _The dwelling place of the Mothershroom. A sacred site in the hearts of the Shroomlings, it seems to possess a mysterious power. Stepping inside makes one's body feel unusually light._

locations.title: Mothershroom Woods North Slope
locations.description: _The wind carries the fresh scent of grass and trees, rustling through the treetops. Streams flow over the rocks, and beneath this tranquil surface, hidden dangers lie in wait._

locations.title: Parkya Crater Adventurer Camp
locations.description: _Parkya Crater Adventurer Camp. Adventurers from afar gather here with awe and anticipation, seeking the unknown within the sleeping volcano._

locations.title: Whoosh-way Exit
locations.description: _At the exit of the Whoosh-way lies the treasure ground of the Shroomlings. Here they dig up volcanic clay, and with the rhythm of their labor, cheerful songs drift through the air._

locations.title: Parkya Lakeheart Island
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete "[Emerging Hidden Traces](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507611)", then use one of the Shroomling Boats.

_Parkya Lakeheart Island. The dormant Parkya Volcano lies wrapped in gentle mist, its former heat now transformed into tranquil stillness by the lakeside._

locations.title: Woodland Cabin
locations.description: _In a little-known corner of Mothershroom Woods, a small house stands quietly, undisturbed._

locations.title: Mothershroom Woods Cavern
locations.description: _The cavern lies hidden between sheer cliffs, where clusters of mushrooms intertwine and conceal one another. Even the Shroomlings who frequently visit Mothershroom Woods rarely notice its presence._

locations.title: Itzaland Canyon West Side
locations.description: _Winding along the twisting path, nameless flowers bloom across the meadows. Before the fated arrival, only the wind can knock upon the door of Itzaland._

locations.title: Mothershroom Woods South Border
locations.description: _The distant, salty sea breeze drifts in, and the outlines of the towering trees fade. The faint roar of the waves stirs the hearts of adventurers, guiding them toward unknown journeys._

locations.title: Crystal Beach
locations.description: _In the higher reaches of the forest, the distant Crystal Beach sparkles under the sunlight, bearing witness to the passage of the Titan civilization._

locations.title: Rockville Ruins
locations.description: _The desolate Rockville has now become a playground for wild beasts, while the traces of Titans have long been eroded by the waves._

locations.title: Luminous Pool Cavern
locations.description: _From the lakeside, distant, dazzling Crystal Beach shimmers with enchanting light, gently adorning the rolling forests beyond._

locations.title: Lumira's Cabin
locations.description: _Magical herbs grow by the clear lakeside, quietly awaiting the arrival of those destined to find them._

locations.title: Shell Island Southeast Wharf (Opposite Bank)
locations.description: _The dock in Mothershroom Woods that leads to Shell Island. Shroomling boatmen wait here, ready to carry fully prepared adventurers safely across the island._

locations.title: Itzaland Interim Stylist's Guild
locations.description: _Stylists gather here in Itzaland, forming a temporary guild where creativity sparks and new ideas bloom._

locations.title: Shell Island Society of Observers Base
locations.description: _The stronghold of the Society of Observers, where members, driven by their devotion to art, treasure the Impressions they acquire, imbuing each with unique meaning._

locations.title: Shell Island West Wharf
locations.description: _At the dock linking Shell Island to the Giant Vine Forest, boats glide across the tranquil lake, bringing the coiling vines into view._

locations.title: Shell Island West Wharf (Opposite Bank)
locations.description: _The dock in the Giant Vine Forest that leads to Shell Island. Behind rise coiling giant vines, and across the lake lies Shell Island. It is a peaceful haven for adventurers to rest and recover._

locations.title: Nameless Flowerfield
locations.description: _On a secluded, unseen slope, nameless little flowers grow and spread quietly._

locations.title: Giant Vine Forest North Adventurer Camp
locations.description: _Among crumbling walls and thriving greenery, adventurers rest, enjoying brief peace as they prepare for tomorrow's journey._

locations.title: Coliseum East Side
locations.description: _Everything is frozen in time. The scenes of the past fade away, and civilization slumbers here._

locations.title: Coliseum North Side
locations.description: _Weathered cracks cover the stone entrance, and towering trees coil among the broken walls and ruins. Each fissure tells the story of a long-buried history._

locations.title: Leaf River Upstream
locations.description: _Leaf River murmurs gently, awaiting a destined traveler to embark on an exhilarating journey along its winding waters._

locations.title: Titan’s Secret Hall Ruins
locations.description: _A mysterious cavern, where only adventurers with sincere hearts and courage can traverse time to uncover the traces of a brilliant civilization._

locations.title: The Titan’s Graveyard
locations.description: _The heavy stone monument stands silently, burying both the fragrance of the flowering trees and the glory of past times._

locations.title: Pottsville
locations.description: _Winding paths flanked by flowers and leaves lead to tiny jar-shaped homes, the warm abodes of little Shroomlings._

locations.title: Misty Forest Entrance
locations.description: _The entrance to Misty Forest. Beyond a heavy door, mysterious fog rapidly spreads, sealing away the remnants of the Titan civilization._

locations.title: Elderwood Wharf
locations.description: _The fine, soft sand stretches out as the waves murmur gently. The footprints of adventurers mark Itzaland, and the prologue of their journey starts here._

locations.title: Great Exploration Camp
locations.description: _Elderwood Forest Grand Adventurer Camp. Adventurers from all lands gather, their hearts burning with curiosity, trading tales of wonder beneath the towering trees._

locations.title: Titan's Workshop Ruins
locations.description: _Countless clay jars huddle together among the ruins, and echoes of the past bustle still inger faintly in the air._

locations.title: Ruins Near Elderwood Shade
locations.description: _Beneath the crumbling bricks, giant vines quitely take root, as the remnants of civilization are slowly reclaimed by the vitality of nature._

locations.title: Coliseum Broken Bridge
locations.description: _Towering trees stand by the broken bridge, branches and leaves interwoven. The wind howls through the bridges remains, and for a fleeting moment, it sounds as though a distant Behemoth is letting out a low, echoing roar._

locations.title: Forest of Slumber
locations.description: _A colossal being slumbers here, a witness to birth and decay alike. Every gaze upon it is a glimpse into the endless cycle of life._

locations.title: Forest Trail
locations.description: _Here, contrasting hues meet by chance. Gold and emerald intertwine in harmony._

locations.title: Giant Vine Forest South Ruins
locations.description: _Green vines drape over the fallen Elderwoods, leaving the ruins in a haunting silence._

locations.title: Coliseum Main Entrance
locations.description:
_The towering stone entrance and crumbling statues were once symbols of wisdom and civilization. Now, only faint echoes of their former glory remain._

**Inside:**
- Whimstar x4
- Dew of Inspiration x33
- Records x5
- Lore Items x3
- Primary Chest x2
- Advanced Chest x1

locations.title: 1F Transfer Station
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 1F

_A giant spear connects Spira and Elderwood Forest, where all Shroomlings traveling between the two places leave their footprints._

locations.title: Shroomling Wall
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 3F

_A giant wall full of doodles. It's a place bursting with inspiration, call all art-loving souls to leave their own colours._

locations.title: Shiny Vault
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 2F

_The Shroomlings' treasure vault. It holds every Shroomling's most precious treasure. Every item here is invaluable and deserves to be handled with great care._

Initially visited during "[Treasures and Secrets](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508550)", the Shiny Vault is then temporarily inaccessible again until you complete "[The Last Song of Battle](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508569)".

**Inside:**
- Whimstar x2
- Dew of Inspiration x18
- Record x4
- Lore Item x1

locations.title: Mothershroom's Dream
locations.description:
_A dazzling, strange cavern filled with bizarre mushrooms. Through confusion and the unknown, the Mothershroom guides the way in dreams, pointing toward the right path._

**Note:** The actual entry for Mothershroom's Dream is located [here](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508).

**Inside:**
- Whimstar x3
- Dew of Inspiration x20
- Record x3
- Advanced Chest x1
- Primary Chest x2

locations.title: Hero's Square
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 1F

_Situated at the square in Spira, it's where the Shroomlings gather during major festivals._

locations.title: 2F Transfer Station
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 2F

_Located on the second floor of Spira, this transfer station bustles with busy Shroomlings as cargo travels overhead on crisscrossing ropeways._

locations.title: Spira's Shelldome
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira's Shelldome

_The ancient Giant Spear pierces through Spira, its tip pointing straight toward the deep starry sky. The radiance of courage flows endlessly here._

locations.title: Rockville Coast
locations.description: _The edge of an abandoned village, where waves pound against silent reefs day and night. The clamor of former days has ebbed with the tide, leaving only the sea wind whispering through crumbling walls and broken stone._

locations.title: Outside Crater Lake Canyon
locations.description: _A mysterious cavern on the eastern side of Parkya Crater Lake. As daylight fades, a quiet river flows on, leading to the place where souls return._

locations.title: Glimmering West Bank
locations.description: _Lumies glimmer lightly upon the water, and silent ripples spread outward, stirring long-slumbering attachment and regret._

locations.title: Bloomvale
locations.description: _A clear spring tumbles down through the mountain ravine, scattering shining droplets that awaken the sleeping earth one by one._

locations.title: Dragonrest Flowerfield
locations.description: _Red blossoms drift through the air, while pale dragon bones stand upon the field like silent monuments, guiding travelers year after year._

locations.title: Whisperwind Slope
locations.description: _The drifting wind carries the fragrance of ancient lands, and a winding slope stretches ahead, leading toward the Parksolians' settlement above._

locations.title: Soul Observatory Colonade Hall
locations.description: _Within this quiet research area, the Parksolians use water as their medium to observe the flow of souls and seek the nature of reincarnation._

locations.title: Great Lumieville Entrance
locations.description: _Entrance to the Parksolians' main settlement. Here they rest and labor, using their sturdy hands to weave long, enduring stories upon this land._

locations.title: Great Lumieville Plaza Elevating Platform
locations.description: _An elevating platform located in the residential area. The Parksolians use it to travel from the upper floor to the Soul Washing Pool. The water circulates in cycles, like endless reincarnation, bearing the Parksolians' vigil and belief._

locations.title: Hall of Return
locations.description:
**Tier:** 1F - Great Lumieville

_Generation after generation, Ferrymen ascend the long stair and enter the Hall of Return. There, they observe the Soul Surge, ferry countless souls, and uphold their ancient duty unchanged through the years._

locations.title: Healing Ground
locations.description: _Here, the Parksolians seek healing from Soulrift, while the music of the Great Soulconch drifts on the air, carrying the fragrance of Dragonbreath Flowers._

locations.title: Soul Tide
locations.description:
_The pool waters sense the cycling of souls in the torrent and spontaneously form a whirlpool at the center. Standing by the pools, one can almost hear the call of souls echoing like crashing waves._

**Contains:**
- Whimstars x2
- Dew of Inspiration x23

locations.title: Blue Pools North Healing Ground Ferry
locations.description: _Following the winding path, the Blue Pools come suddenly into view. Its waters are clear to the very bottom, as though the gods had left their purest color behind._

locations.title: Tidefoam Beach: Lookout Bay
locations.description: _Waves gently brush the white shore, carrying away footprints both deep and shallow, along with stories scattered by time._

locations.title: Outskirts Hillside Meadow
locations.description: _The meadow atop Great Lumieville. Warm sunlight bathes the grassland, and the breeze wanders by, carrying laughter from afar._

locations.title: Memorial Site
locations.description: _Five years ago, an abnormal Soul Tide claimed the lives of many Parksolians. Monuments were raised here in remembrance, where people mourn the family and friends they lost. Of once-vivid lives, only carved traces remain._

locations.title: Blue Pools East Cultivarium Ferry
locations.description: _Boats drift gently at the ferry, accompanying the children who travel to and from the Cultivarium through one quiet day after another._

locations.title: Cultivarium
locations.description: _A place of learning for the Parksolians, where young faces gather and thought meets imagination._

locations.title: Cultivarium Coast
locations.description: _This is where Parksolian children learn. Many skilled artisans and scholars began their journey from this very coast._

locations.title: Dragon's Lair Peak Waterfall Summit
locations.description: _Tier upon tier, the waterfall plunges down as it has for centuries. Amid the drifting mist, long-silent memories begin to loosen within the spray._

locations.title: Forgotten Pass, Dragon's Lair Peak
locations.description: _A temporary dwelling built by the Parksolians' ancestors, abandoned for millennia. Climb the long, weathered steps and brush away the dust--traces of the past may still be found._

locations.title: Soul Spring Lake
locations.description: _In Parksolian legend, the God of Reincarnation was born within Soul Spring Lake atop Dragon's Lair Peak. The towering summit overlooks its waters in silence, guarding this sacred land of the divine._

locations.title: Tablet of the Pact
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete "[The Finale of Fading Souls](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=566659)"

_This great stone tablet has slept beside the Soul Spring for a thousand years, while the ancient pact slowly emerges from its weathered carvings._

locations.title: Hollowbreath Passage Outer Trail
locations.description: _Broken stones and wild grass have buried this lonely trail, along with the stories of dragons from a thousand years ago._

locations.title: Lakeshore Camp
locations.description: _Adventurers make camp and rest here, trading food and information as they wait beside the tranquil lake for the right moment to venture deeper into the Boneyard._

locations.title: Dragon Ruins
locations.description: _Remnants from the age of dragons. Now the Parksolians gather here to hold meetings and perform rituals. Standing beneath the towering stone pillars, one can almost still hear the solemn cry of dragons._

locations.title: Lonestone Shore
locations.description: _Fierce waves crash against the cliffs, and few make their homes here. Only a single bone tent remains, firmly staked into the rock between the crags._

locations.title: Realm of the Past
locations.description:
_A crimson garden woven from memories of the past. It was once filled with laughter, loss, and despair, until she walked toward her end amid the ruins._

**Contains:**
- Whimstar x2
- Dew of Inspiration x9

locations.title: Gatefront Dock
locations.description: _Wings retract, stirring up whirlwinds. The hum of gears weaves into a song._

locations.title: Heaven's Reach Gatefront
locations.description: _The old gateway to Heaven's Reach is now only visited by the sound of winds blowing past wild grass._

locations.title: Corridor of Royal Vestiges
locations.description: _It's a long corridor lush with greenery, where scholars and artisans often come to stroll and reflect in peace._

locations.title: Palace of the Three Divine
locations.description: _One shows past memories. One hears current thoughts. One incubates future inspiration._

locations.title: The Golden Hour
locations.description: _Reason and joy melt into each other under the amber sky. Laugh to your heart's content, for now is the golden hour._

locations.title: Musical Garden
locations.description: _Among the hanging flowered vines, one can still glimpse the figures of Titans raising cups in laughter, conversing and debating, and embracing as they confide in one another._

locations.title: Dawn Market
locations.description: _This was once the liveliest, most prosperous commercial district around, and also a place to host grand gatherings._

locations.title: Marketside Dock
locations.description: _Mechanical birds arrive here laden with cargo, while traders steam into the market like the tide._

locations.title: Shroomsera Nursery
locations.description: _A place where Titans once discussed district affairs, now a resting spot for young Shroomseras._

locations.title: Praxis Plaza
locations.description: _The greatness of Heaven's Reach lies not in gold, but in the thoughts its citizens think, the words they speak, and the views they behold as they walk through its streets._

locations.title: Center District
locations.description: _The intersecting streets offer plenty of room for the passing mechanical beings and the occasional frolicking Shroomseras._

locations.title: Artificer Court Ruins
locations.description: _What once accomodated the finest artisans now lies in ruins, mostly submerged in the lake._

locations.title: District Clock Tower
locations.description: _A bell tower housing precision clockwork that once chimed brightly during celebrations past._

locations.title: Candy Works Entrance
locations.description: _This sweet creation, ripened in the Garden, shatters between the gears, bursting forth with a moment of laughter and golden light._

locations.title: Fullbloom Celebration
locations.description:
_In a Shroomsera's eyes, the land of happiness flows with nectar and ambrosia._

**Contains:**
- Whimstars x5
- Dew of Inspiration x14

locations.title: Everbloom Garden
locations.description: _In the Everbloom Garden, constant harvests are achieved not through nature's pulse, but through spinning cogs._

locations.title: Garden 1F Planting Area
locations.description: _Water courses silently through the planting area, where fruit hang heavily on the vines in the light._

locations.title: Garden 2F
locations.description: _An evergreen garden, raised by gears, that quietly spread warmth and joy throughout Heaven's Reach during the fruiting season._

locations.title: Center Market
locations.description: _A market located in the Center District, offering a vast selection of goods despite its small size._

locations.title: Sol Gate
locations.description: _Most of the mechanisms at the gate to the Golden Court halted after the fall of the Titans._

locations.title: Candy Works Upper Floor
locations.description: _Sometimes, sunlight spills gently across the space, bathing the entire Golden Tooth Candy Works in a warm, golden glow._

locations.title: Golden Court Side Door
locations.description: _A side door reserved for repairment, set into the side of the Golden Court like a silent gear._

locations.title: Golden Court Bridgeside
locations.description: _The bridge stretches across the lake, leading to the dazzling yet silent Golden Court._

locations.title: Theater of Lament
locations.description: _This theater still stands as proudly as it did back in the golden age, but its songs have long been lost to the wind._

locations.title: Theater 2F
locations.description: _Slanting rays of sunlight quietly fill the theater covered in the silent dust of yesterday's applause._

locations.title: Golden Court Plaza
locations.description: _On the ever-so-grand plaza before the Golden Court, Cogbuds travel on paths unchanged for a thousand years._

locations.title: Plazafront Dock
locations.description: _The once lively dock has long since been forgotten, occupied only by the low hum of the wind passing through the empty corridors._

locations.title: Perennial Library
locations.description: _Stone tablets stack into steps. Pages spread into rivers. Here, thought collide and leave their mark, never ceasing._

locations.title: Corridor of Intellects
locations.description: _Unfinished manuscripts pile up in the long corridor, where knowledge is tempered into its purest form._

locations.title: Hall Fields
locations.description: _Wind blows past the fields by the Hall, picking up echoes of old wisdom between blades of grass._

locations.title: Hall of Elucidation
locations.description: _This was once the cradle of civilization, where the greatest minds lit up an entire era._

locations.title: Golden Court Back Door
locations.description: _Broken Colonnades float in midair, like a tomb slowly drowning into the sky._

locations.title: Golden Court Side Ruins
locations.description: _The Golden Court hangs high above, its shadow marred by scar-like ruins._

locations.title: Golden Court Corner
locations.description: _The green vines and dappled sunlight seem to be telling stories of the past._

locations.title: Golden Court Backdoor Dock
locations.description: _The rusted Automaton rests with its wings retracted, as if still waiting for a ceremony that has long since concluded._

locations.title: Golden Court Top Terrace
locations.description:
_Looking down from the tallest point of the Golden Court, Heaven's Reach appears like a vast, age-old dream, shimmering like a lake as it ripples silently across the horizon._

To get here, complete [Golden Court Back Door](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=930642) a second time by using the two blue doorway portals.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Temple of Wishes](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420630)

**Location:** Not at all intuitive to get to. From this pair of Dews, face northeast through the split in the tree trunk to see these three Dews on a branch. To get here, jump out, glide and stay as close to the trunk on the right-hand side to land at the base of the branch, letting you walk up to them (this is what's shown in our first screenshot).

You can alternatively jump down here from the [Garrison of the Paladins Warp Spire](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420640), as shown in our second screenshot. It's effectively a blind jump, and you can't use Floral Gliding here like in the Abandoned District!
