locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438)'s Reserve Vault section. In the final room with the large rolling barrels, make it to the platform with the stairs, then turn right to spot another large barrel. Roll it forward into a broken section of the wall: the Dew will be in here on the right.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Tier:** Golden Fields 2F

**Location:** Below the Stonetree overhang, next to a tree.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438)'s Transport Path. At the bottom of the first mine cart track, check the wooden walkway that wraps around the corner to find these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the first room of the Broken Hallway section, cross over the rotating column, then go right across the gap. Defeat the Esselings here, then check the back-right corner to find these Dews behind some rubble.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the second, larger room of the Broken Hallway section. Jump forward onto the square red column, which will tip leftwards. When it stops, turn around to spot these Dews hovering down the edge to the right of the entrance door.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the second, larger room of the Broken Hallway section. After making it to the other side, head right and check behind the smashable boxes to find these.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the Palace Old Courtyard area. From the central violin statue, turn left to find a ruined building. Climb onto it via the columns on the left-hand side, then go anti-clockwise around the balcony. The Dews will be at the end, hidden behind some rubble.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the Palace Old Courtyard area. From the central violin statue, turn left to find a ruined building. Climb up to the very top it via the columns on the left-hand side, then go to the corner closest to the violin statue. Glide on top of the nearest archway structure to find these Dews!

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the Palace Old Courtyard area's flooded room. From the entrance, head left and jump down to the tiled square platform below. There, face the direction of the entry door, and you'll spot these Dews on a ledge to your left, tucked inside a corner.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the Doll Gallery area. From the checkpoint marker, jump forward across the gap, then head right around the glass cases to find these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the Doll Gallery area. From the checkpoint marker, jump forward across the gaps to the clockwork guard. Jump off the left-hand edge to the walkway below, then walk under the clockwork guard to find these Dews!

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the Doll Gallery area. From the checkpoint marker, jump forward across the gaps to the clockwork guard, then drop left onto the walkway and head to the platform area. Jump across the square red columns that tilt when you step on them: on the third, look left to spot these Dews in the alcove.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the Doll Gallery area. From the checkpoint marker, jump forward across the gaps to the clockwork guard, then drop left onto a walkway leading to a platforming section. At the end of the tilting red columns, jump left to find a side area: the Dews will be in a small room here next to [a Lore Item](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=493800).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Palace Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=436014). After the second and third rolling columns, you can find these behind a snapped column in the back-right corner.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Palace Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=436014). After jumping through the hole behind the glass cases, check the back-left corner to find these behind the rubble.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Palace Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=436014). After jumping through the hole behind the glass cases, turn right and glide across to the square island in the water. Here, turn around to spot the Dews on your right.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Palace Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=436014). After dropping through the hole in the wall to the upper level, turn right and head for the corner with glass cases: the Dews will be there.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Palace Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=436014). After dropping through the hole in the wall to the upper level, head to the back-right corner of the level. In this small area will be the Dew, floating above the largest glass case.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Palace Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=436014). After dropping through the hole in the wall to the upper level, head for the area in the back-left corner, guarded by many Esselings. The Dew will be in the corner, and can be reached by standing on top of some glass cases nearby.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Temple of Wishes](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420630)

**Location:** Jump up to the first Confetti Cannon platform behind the Temple of Wishes building. Here, face north to spot these Dews floating atop a branch of the tree, which you can get to with careful climbing.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' opening area. Check the bottom of the crystal serpent to find these in an alcove.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' opening area. When you approach the top of the crystal serpent in this section where the shielded Lonely Sack is, turn around and jump on top of the mossy rock formation it passes by, with a Jelly Pouch Esseling on it. From here you can follow some Blings to glide across to a ledge, with these Dews tucked on the far end.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Karst Cave of Blue Tears area. When the catapult activates, head left to find a hole in the ground near some wooden walls: drop down here to find these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Karst Cave of Blue Tears area. When travelling down a sandy path near the water, you'll spot these floating near the distant wall on your right. To reach these, have the catapult fire a rock nearby, then jump onto it to grab it with a Purification attack.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Karst Cave of Blue Tears area. Karst Cave of Blue Tears area. After [the previous Dews of Inspiration](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464346), you'll climb up some ledges to some wooden walls lit by a torch.

Turn left and glide over to a new area. Head clockwise around the rock column, then use the catapult to place a rock so you can jump up to these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Karst Cave of Blue Tears area. From the [Whimstar](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464349), jump towards where the wooden walls were to land on an island. These Dews will be floating next to a small rock column sticking out of the water on your left.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Karst Cave of Blue Tears area. Early into this area, you'll cross over a second of the crystal serpent to a sandy area. On the right-hand side is a high wall: use one of the catapult's boulders to jump up here and go down this path.

After you get past some ballista traps, check behind the rock pillar on your left to find these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Karst Cave Depths area. These Dews will be on a small, lower ledge at the very end.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Karst Cave Depths area. On the crystal serpent, you'll find these floating just past the second wooden platform, the one with the Jelly Pouch Esseling on it.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Cliffside Walkway area. Early into the climb, these will be just off a tiny platform on the left-hand side. You'll need to move the camera around in order to see these and the platform.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Cliffside Walkway area. Midway into the climb you'll come across the first multi-level platform. Just past this platform on the left will be another platform, letting you grab these nearby Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Ancient Pool Ruins area. From the checkpoint post, turn left to find a small pool. These Dews will be tucked away on the left-hand wall of this area.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Ancient Pool Ruins area. After the [Whimstar](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464360), you'll jump around ledges over a large pool and emerge back onto the crystal serpent. Here, look right down the serpent to find these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Ancient Pool Ruins area. After [the previous Dew of Inspiration](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464361), climb to the top of the crystal serpent to find a long tunnel. At the start of the runnel, keep an eye out on your right to find these Dews tucked in an alcove!

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Market of Mirth Entrance Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420934), floating next to a wall at the top of the vertical wind shaft.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Market of Mirth Entrance Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420934). After dropping down the hole in the tunnel mid-way down the vertical wind shaft, turn around to spot these above the bales of hay.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Market of Mirth Entrance Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420934). In the tunnel at the bottom of the vertical wind shaft, turn right to find these at the dead end guarded by Esselings.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof of the house, next to the chimney

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Above a tree behind the [Gliding: Ring Pass](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=417526)

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Ghost Train](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) lobby hallway. After the first corner, these will be floating at the backside of the overhead sign.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** On the [Ghost Train](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499). From the starting carriage, head backwards one train car to get to the car with wooden floors and a tall zig-zagging wall. These Dews will be behind the zig-zagging wall.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** On the [Ghost Train](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499). From [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=495061), head one train car back to find a wooden-floored carriage with a large wooden structure on the left-hand side. Check the back of this structure to find these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** On the [Ghost Train](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499). From the starting train car, head forward through the first passenger car and out to the first car with a patrolling ghost. The structure on the back-left of this car has these Dews on top, which you can reach by approaching this backwards.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** On the [Ghost Train](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499). After the first "jumpscare" ghost pop-up, jump onto the next car, then turn around to face backwards. On your left will be a side area on the previous train car, which is where these Dews are.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Heavy-Duty Flatbed area. Right after the checkpoint, head forward to encounter your first cat ghost. At this spot, turn around to spot these Dews in the back of the large wooden structure.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Heavy-Duty Flatbed area. After your second ghost pop-up jumpscare on this train, make your way up to the top of the tall structure on the right-hand side of the next train car (it connects to a ghost-guarded walkway). Check the back of it to find a lower ledge with these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Heavy-Duty Flatbed area. After [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=495158), you'll have to climb up on top of a tall structure to get to two walkways guarded by ghosts.

Get to the end of the first walkway, then keep left and jump to a tower of hay bales (bewaring for another ghost pop-up jumpscare). These Dews will be right behind this hay bale tower.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Shipping Boxcar area. From the checkpoint podium, head forward to the spot where a ghost is patrolling in circles. Check the back of the structure on the right-hand side to find these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Heavy-Duty Flatbed area. From [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=495075), look forward up the train and spot the large structure on the right-hand side. Check the back of this structure to find a slot in the middle with these Dews inside.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Shipping Boxcar area. After running along the top of the traincars, check the back of the wooden structure on the left-hand side to find these Dews in a hidden section.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Volunteer Corps Camp Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419514). After defeating the first Esselings, head forward to the next gap: these Dews will be floating on the left near a lamp post.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Volunteer Corps Camp Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419514). From the ledge with the [Primary Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=496077), face away from the wall to spot these Dews floating ahead on the left.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** At the end of the [Volunteer Corps Camp Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419514). After using a Spring Leaf to bounce up to a higher rocky walkway, head uphill to the top and look left to spot these Dews in the corner.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stellar Fishing Ground 2F

**Location:** Floating at the southwestern edge of the stonetree, behind a large rock formation.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** After passing Barabo to the south, you'll see an open pool section on the right. Jump to the rock formation in the middle of the pool, then drop down to the lower ledge on its southern side. You can spot these Dews floating under an overhang of the main path.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Inspection Center Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420082). When you enter the large round room with the rock podium in the middle, this pair of Dews will be up a ledge on the left-hand wall, guarded by an Esseling.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Inspection Center Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420082). From [the first pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497076), jump across the ledges to the entrance of the large round room to find these Dews floating in the entryway.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Inspection Center Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420082). After going through a hallway with pools of water that you cross as Momo, you'll come to the top of a cliff overlooking a small arena filled with Esselings. before jumping down there, head left along the edge of the cliff to find a small hole in the ground with these Dews inside.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Waterfall Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421602). When you enter the first room, head right to the back side of the rock column to find these Dews floating against it.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Waterfall Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421602), at the end of the first room where the Punceria plant is. Instead of going through the tunnel as Momo, climb up the Woven Pillar to find these Dews at the top.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Waterfall Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421602). Fromr [the previous Primary Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497685), you'll climb up another Woven Pillar as Momo. At the top, jump up to the next area to spot a pool on your left: you can spot these Dews here, floating under a rocky walkway with Esselings on it.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Waterfall Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421602). From [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497686), jump up the ledges to find three Esselings on the rock bridge. Instead of crossing it, look down to the pool below to spot some lilypads you can jump down to. The Dews can be collected from the lilypads, floating against the rock wall to the left of them.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Farm Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422322), In the waterlogged chasm area. Jump down to the lilypads on the water to get to them.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x4
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Farm Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422322). From [the previous Advanced Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497712), revert back to Nikki and turn around: you'll spot these four Dews in a doorway leading back to the waterlogged chasm.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Farm Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422322), in the same chasm as [the previous Intermediate Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497715). Drop one level down and turn to face the entryway to find a small pool of water, with these Dews floating above it.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Farm Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422322). These are technically at the bottom of the vertical shaft from earlier: to get them without Plunging into the deep water, wait until you emerge into the second waterlogged chasm area. At the start of it, look right to spot a hole you can jump to and safely reach these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Farm Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422322). After using the two trampolines in the second waterlogged charm, turn left to spot these three Dews ahead on the right-hand wall.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Farm Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422322). From [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497720), continue forward until you land on a rock bridge heading uphill to the right. Face up it, and you'll see these Dews on the left-hand side of it.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Farm Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422322). Will be _BEHIND_ the large yellow tree at the end of the main path!

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Timis's Beauty Lab](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123). When you get to the end of the first conveyor belt room, switch to Nikki and plunge on the wooden panel. You'll drop into a lower area with these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Auroma Extraction Room area. From the checkpoint marker, look for the platform at water level, behind the large green cylinders.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Auroma Extraction Room area. After using the third conveyor belt, you'll land on top of a giant perfume vial. Here, look left to spot these Dews atop another giant perfume vial.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Auroma Extraction Room area. At the exit to the next purple room, ignore it and drop down the square hole in the floor nearby. When you land, turn around to spot these Dews in an alcove.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description:
**Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Cosmetic Assembly Line area. At a certain point you'll come across a room with two conveyor belts with a gap between them, and two crushes on the farther belt just before safe ground.

You'll want to jump onto and ride up the second crusher: from there you can jump left to a ledge with these Dews. You can't do that on the first crusher though, that has a superheated top that will hurt you if you try standing on it!

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description:
**Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Cosmetic Assembly Line area. At a certain point you'll go down a conveyor belt with a corner and jump up to a safe area with a drop on the left-hand side that leads to a conveyor belt.

Here, jump onto the first crusher (marked with Blings), then turn around. On the wall you'll see a ledge you can jump to with these Dews on it.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Cosmetic Assembly Line area. From [the previous trio of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=499099), continue down and jump off the conveyor belt to land in a small room, with these Dews in the right-hand window.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Cleansing Oil Workshop area. From the checkpoint marker, head around the corner to a tiny door only Momo can fit through. Look to the left of it to spot these Dews, between the wall and some glass bottles.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Garrison of the Paladins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420640)

**Location:** On a branch above the Wishball field. Despite this, you can only access it by dropping down from the Garrison of the Paladin's Tier above. The best spot is where the Confetti Cannon is, or the nearby Piecey dummy training area.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Garrison of the Paladins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420640)

**Location:** Floating high above the platforms leading down to [the Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420641), and near [this Advanced Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420646).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Garrison of the Paladins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420640)

**Location:** One of the most out-of-the-way Dews in the game. From [this trio of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=499536), look north to spot these Dews on another large branch. You'll have to glide across from the branch you're currently on to get to these three Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Garrison of the Paladins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420640)

**Location:** Very out-of-the-way Dews. Use the Confetti Cannon in the Garrison of the Paladins to make to the higher platform. Here, go to the northern end of the barricade and look northeast.

Ahead will be a large tree branch with these Dews on it, although they're obscured by leaves. To get to them, glide to the base of the branch where the Desperation Vines are, letting you climb up to these Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Garrison of the Paladins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420640)

**Location:** Off the eastern side of the Garrison of the Paladins tier. Head for the Piecey dummy training area, and you'll spot these on a branch stretching out to the east.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Temple of Wishes](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420630)

**Location:** On a branch below the northern edge of the Wishball field platform. This is around about where the eastern Confetti Cannon at the Grand Tree Residential Area will shoot you, after "[Repair the Confetti Cannon](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=500387)".

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Garrison of the Paladins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420640)

**Location:** On a branch east-southeast of the Confetti Cannon that shoots you up to the top of the Grand Millewish Tree.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) opening area. After getting past the first Iron Squirrel and riding up a fan as Momo, turn left and look up to spot these Dews floating above a large metal pipe in the corner.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Sword Courtyard area. From the checkpoint, ride up the fan as Momo: at the very top, you'll spot these Dews on a ledge, through a giant metal gear.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Sword Courtyard area. After going down a metal pipe you'll exit onto some metal gears, with water and a fan on your left. Check the back wall to find these Dews hidden under one of the gears.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Sword Courtyard area. Towards the end of this area you'll cross over a ruined stone bridge. Down on the left-hand side is some wooden scaffolding: jump down and follow it to the end to find these Dews floating under the bridge.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Location:** Among the large structures made of large leaves, floating above some hay.

Clearing these triggers dialogue for the “Hello, Ian the Cadenceborn” World Quest

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Floating at the top of an arch. Can be collected using Archery.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Floating very high up in the air. Can only be collected by climbing up to [this Advanced Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507254).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Floating just under the end of the pier.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Floating in a wooden wheelbarrow at the end of the pier.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s opening area. From [the first Whimstar](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507489), head down the path going to a huge spiral shell, then head left down the corridor to another intersection with pink mushrooms in the middle. The Dews are head on a ledge of the back wall: get up here by jumping from the pink mushrooms.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s opening area, at the end of the tunnel where you find [Dream of the Fireflies Record](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507497). It'll be up among some roots, and on your initial visit also guarded by two shielded Esselings.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s Mirage Realm area. From the checkpoint, jump across the gap and use the mushroom to bounce up to the next corridor. Before moving on, turn around and look left to spot these Dews hovering in the air.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s Mirage Realm area. After going down the ramp to the large area with the lake, make a U-turn to your left. In this small tunnel will be these three Dews, and in your initial visit they'll also be guarded by a pair of shielded Esselings.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s Mirage Realm area, in the same room as the [Follow the Light Record](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507495), floating above the pool of water. Can be collected using the Archery ability.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s Mirage Realm area. They will be floating over the edge near [the previous Primary Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508596).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s Vein Ruins area. When you get to the third green mushroom that forms a safe area when Nikki steps on it with Gigantification, turn left to spot a small side-room. These Dews will be in here, guarded by three Esselings (but only during your initial visit here).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s Vein Ruins area, floating above the cliff where [the Advanced Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507502) is.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Floating atop this blue crystal peak.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s opening area. Right at the first corner, turn right through the tree to find these Dews in the shaded alcove area.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s opening area. When you go through a crack in a wall as normal-sized Nikki, stop and check above it to spot these Dews floating in front of a small window. You can hit these with the Archery ability.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Corridor of Glory. In the section where you're chased by the Behemoth, you'll duck into a side area that ends in a storeroom with a hole leading down a floor. Before jumping down the hole, use the boxes on the right-hand wall to climb onto the wooden shelving, with these Dews at the top.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Corridor of Glory. After [the previous three Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507684), you'll go through a short pipe section and emerge in front of a huge wooden table. The music sheet will be behind the table.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Corridor of Glory. In the huge Titan King statue room, look for these directly under the entry platform from the [An Ancient Record](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507687) Lore Item.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Corridor of Glory. In the huge Titan King statue room, check one of the corners to find a wooden cupboard unit. These Dews will be inside of them, and guarded by Esselings.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Champion Exhibition Hall. After gliding over a gap with the Behemoth underneath, check the back-left corner of the room to find these Dews between some wooden boxes.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Champion Exhibition Hall. From [the previous three Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507713), run along the edge of the wall to the adjacent room. Here, look for a stop in the back-left corner to drop down to the lower floor. Here will be a box in the water with these Dews atop it.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Champion Exhibition Hall. After gliding down to a cutscene, you'll be facing a large wooden table. Here, check the back-left wall to find a hole to a corridor, with these Dews floating near the distant wall. You can hit these with Archery, or wait until you remove the Behemoth to access these more easily.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Hidden Corridor. In the room the Behemoth falls down, these will be floating on the floor to the left of the brass cauldron in the middle of the room.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Hidden Corridor. On the second floor of the "Behemoth Elevator" section, head into the curved side area. Ignore the horn and head around to the end: these Dews will be floating above some wooden boxes in the back-left corner.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside a broken vase on top of the giant wooden shelving.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the ruined wall, accessible by gliding from the [Primary Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507732).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the end of this tree stump.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). In the first room with the bridge, these Dews will be floating above the large wooden structures on the right-hand wall.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). From the previous Primary Chest, look right towards the entrance to the next room: you'll spot these Dews in front of it, close to the water level.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x5
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification during "[Beware of the Behemoth!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507478)".

**Location:** A super-sized Dew floating under the petals of the Cheer-Up Bloom. Roar at the Cheer-Up Bloom with Gigantification to access this, then Purify it to split it into five Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). In the room with the stack of crates in the middle, jump up on top of the crate stack and look for these Dews in the back-left corner, under some wooden scaffolding.

Despite the picture above, it's actually easier to hit these using Archery from *under* the scaffolding!

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). These will be on a bench on the scaffolding up in the room with the crate stack in the middle.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). From the room with the stack of crates in the middle, head for the next area with the big desk guarded by Esselings. These Dews will be hiding among another stack of boxes on the left-hand wall.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). In the room with the desk and Esselings, check between the entrance and exit of the room to find a dark alcove, with these Dews floating above the bookcase there.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). From the giant Whimstar room, head for the exit and jump up the first set of ledges. At the top, turn around to spot these Dews floating on a ledge above where you entered.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). From [the previous three Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507779), continue to the sunlit room and locate the high ledge with a Spring Leaf on it. Use it to glide left to a ledge with these Dews on them.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). After climbing up from [the previous Advanced Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507777), you'll find yourself at an intersection with a tall red plant in the middle. These Dews will be floating above the plant, and can be hit with Archery.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 1F

**Location:** Floating on a tiny tower on the roof of the building leading back to [the Snail Ranch](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=505487).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Vault Bottom area. From [the music sheet Record](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508553), locate an orange Sticky Claw ledge up ahead. These Dews will be below that platform.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Vault Bottom area. From the platform above [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508552), look up to the right to spot a second Sticky Claw ledge you can grapple up to. These Dews will be here in front of some treasure chests.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Vault Bottom area. In the curved corridor filled with walls of alarm bell strings, keep an eye on the ceiling to an orange Sticky Claw panel above a cluster of alarm bell strings. Below and to the left of the Sticky Claw panel is a ledge with these Dews, which you can reach using the panel.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Vault Mid-Level Exhibition Rotunda area. From the checkpoint, look left to see a stack of chests: jump to the top of them to find these Dews on your left, on the top-most shelf of the display cabinet.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Vault Mid-Level Exhibition Rotunda area. From the previous Whimstar, jump up the ledges to the right to find these Dews at the end.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Inside a tree stump.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Floating in the branches of the yellow tree. Get to these by riding [the Shroomling Boat to the south](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508579), then standing up and jumping off.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Jar Storage Room area. From [the previous Lore Item](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508597), check to the right of it to find a way to get behind the shelves, over some square drawers. These Dews will be here, inside one of the shelves.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Jar Storage Room area. From [the previous Lore Item](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508597), turn around and use the orange Sticky Claw ledge to get up on top. Head clockwise around the shelves and, after the second jump, look right to spot these two Dews.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Floating above a torch on the wall. Can be hit with Archery.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Up the coliseum wall. Get up here using the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508934).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x4
locations.description: **Location:** Up on the wall of the coliseum, floating in front of a giant wooden door at the hanging planks of wood. Get up here using the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508934).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** On the upper wall of the coliseum, behind a fallen chunk of wall. Get up here using the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508934).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x4
locations.description: **Location:** Inside a tiny window up the coliseum wall. To get here you'll need to use the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508934), make your way over here, then keep an eye for these Dews on your right as you run along the large vine.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Will be a large Dew floating on top of the shelves in this giant shelter.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x4
locations.description: **Location:** A large Dew floating above the southwestern post of this blue shelter.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Floating under a log that spans across the river.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Under the huge vine near the shore, and guarded by Esselings.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Floating on the underside of the giant vine.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Spira's Shelldome](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042)

**Location:** Floating near the tip of the Shelldome, on the northeastern side.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Spira's Shelldome](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042)

**Location:** Floating near the tip of a spike near the top of the Shelldome, on the northeastern side.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Spira's Shelldome](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042)

**Location:** A trio of Dews floating in a circle near a spike of the Shelldome. There will be some Esselings guarding this spike nearby.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Spira's Shelldome](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042)

**Location:** From the [Spira's Shelldome Warp Spire](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042), face the middle of the Shelldome, then go left downhill to spot these Dews floating near the tree and the rock wall.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Spira's Shelldome](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042)

**Location:** A trio of Dews floating in a circle, just off the southern-most spike of Spira's Shelldome.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Spira's Shelldome](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042)

**Location:** Floating off a spike of the Spira Shelldome, close to the top of a tree below.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Spira's Shelldome](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042)

**Location:** On the eastern side of Spira's Shelldome on one of the middle levels, hidden in some bushes.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x4
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Spira's Shelldome](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042)

**Location:** A large Dew on the northwestern side of the Spira Shelldome. Will split into four smaller Dews when shot.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** In the back of a giant wooden cart.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Floating above the front door to the Snail Clinic, up in the rafters of the roof.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Floating just under the roof rafters.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x4
locations.description: **Location:** A large Dew up in the treetops. You can glide to here from the roof of the Snail Clinic.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** A large Dew up in the treetops. You can get up here by using [this Titan's Super Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=510155).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x4
locations.description: **Location:** A large Dew up in the treetops. You can get up here by gliding to [this Dew](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509794) from the roof of the Snail Clinic.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x4
locations.description: **Location:** Up in the treetops. You can get up here by gliding to [this Dew](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509794) from the roof of the Snail Clinic.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Hiding inside the log.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x4
locations.description: **Location:** Floating at the top of one of the large plants. You can get here by jumping up a rock to the south of it.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** Hidden inside the hollow log.

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x4
locations.description: **Location:** A large Dew up in the treetops. You can get up here by using the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509817).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** A trio of smaller Dews in the lower canopy of the trees. You can get up here by using the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509817).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** Up in the tree tops. You can get here by using the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509813).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3
locations.description: **Location:** A large Dew up in the tree tops. You can get here by using the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509813).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x2
locations.description: **Location:** A pair of Dews up in the tree tops. You can get up here by using the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509817).

locations.title: Dew of Inspiration x3

The Whimstar will be there.

locations.title: Falling into a Dream
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin "[Go to the Dream Warehouse!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=456872)"

**Location:** In the [Dream Warehouse](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=417462) After the Corner area. After the two sets of origami crane platforms, you'll be on a platform with a huge gash in the middle. From here, just left up the long curved series of origami crane platforms and ride a platform up to the top of the tower. The music sheet will be on the balcony below the top of the tower, under a curved stone overhang.

**Album:** Songs of Flowers and Wishes-02

From the checkpoint podium, face away from the entrance and note the three wish bottle nooks on the right-hand side of the room. The music sheet will be in the farthest of the three, above the wooden crates on the back wall.

locations.title: Golden Fields Records
locations.description:
**Location:** On the stone bench at under the window of this house.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 02

**Songs:**
- Golden Fields
- Yesterday's Harvest
- Fields Serenade
- The Scarecrow's Dream

locations.title: Ripple Estate Records
locations.description:
**Location:** On the barrels to the left of the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438).

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 02

**Songs:**
- Fragrant Ripples
- Fragrances of Days Gone By
- Brewing in Tranquility
- A Small Sip

locations.title: Prosperville Records
locations.description:
**Tier:** Windrider Mill 3F

**Location:** On a barrel at the base of the windmill.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 02

**Songs:**
- The Forgotten
- Mending Fabric, Mending Lives
- An Endless Search
- The Silent Old Village

locations.title: The First Ripple
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438). As soon as you start, turn left to spot this floating above a barrel in the corner.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: A Feast of Fragrances
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438)'s Transport Path. Before jumping on the second mine cart, check the barrel to the right of it to find this music sheet. If you accidentally take the mine cart, jump off to respawn back at the start of its track.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: Fast Forward
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438)'s Reserve Vault section. When you get to the open section with the moving barrels, check the back-left corner of the starting area to find this music sheet floating above some small wooden barrels.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: Echoes of the Cellar
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438)'s Office section. As soon as you enter, collect this floating above the small trolley on the left-hand wall.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: Ripples in Time
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438)'s Office section. Head into the side-room (to the right of the checkpoint post) to find this on the desk in the middle.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: Lingering Fragrances
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438)'s Office section. In the final arena-like room of the cellar, check the back-right corner lit by sunlight to find this music sheet next to an award.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: Choo-Choo Train Records
locations.description:
**Location:** Floating above a box on the northern side of the train stop.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

**Songs:**
- Journey to Prosperity
- Stonewoods Touring

locations.title: Market of Mirth Records
locations.description:
**Tier:** Market of Mirth 3F

**Location:** Floating above a box on the side of the blue circus tent.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 02

**Songs:**
- The Call of Joy
- Dancing With Joy
- Listening to a Faraway Tale
- The Curtain Call

locations.title: Stellar Fishing Ground
locations.description:
**Location:** On some boxes at the eastern corner of the walkway.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 02

locations.title: Floral Gliding Records
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stellar Fishing Ground 2F

**Location:** On the boxes on the platform that lets you glide up to the highest stonetree here.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

**Songs:**
- Floral Gliding: Wishes
- Floral Gliding: Bliss

locations.title: Wishes Under a Starry Sky
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stellar Fishing Ground 2F

**Location:** Floating in the grass under the pink-leaved tree.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: Choo-Choo Station Records
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the second train carriage.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 02

**Songs:**
- Choo-Choo, the Whistle Blows
- Awaiting the Next Stop
- The Empty Platform
- The Last Train

locations.title: The Ghost Train
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Ghost Train](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) lobby hallway. Right at the beginning, look on the left-hand wall to find this music sheet on the corner of the countertop.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: Ghosts at Play
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Heavy-Duty Flatbed area. After reaching this checkpoint, jump to the next car and get past the cat ghost. As you head forward on the ground, keep an eye out on your right for this music sheet floating above some wooden barrels.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: Ghost Train in Silence
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Heavy-Duty Flatbed area. From [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=495077), look down to the back-right corner of the train car to spot this music sheet at the base of the tower structure.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: The Ghost Dance
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Passenger Car area. After the checkpoint podium, head into the passenger car ahead and look for this music sheet on a table on the right-hand side, near a Piecey sitting on a floating box.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: Stop the Train!
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Passenger Car area. When you get to the second train car with farm-style standees and haystacks, check a round haystack with a pumpkin scarecrow to find this music sheet.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: Storm Records
locations.description:
**Tier:** Prosperville 2F

**Location:** Floating above a low hay bale, at the northern end of the shelter where Raggy hangs out after completing "[To the Pinnacle: Stonecrown!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=489299)".

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

**Songs:**
- A Treacherous Storm
- The Storm Unleashed

locations.title: Windrider Mill Records
locations.description:
**Location:** Floating next to the window at the front of this house.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 02

**Songs:**
- A Golden Harvest
- Windmill in the Breeze
- The Grinding Mill
- Fragrances in the Wind

locations.title: A Small Invitation
locations.description:
**Location:** On the desk of Lupabo's spot.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 01

locations.title: Grand Millewish Tree Records
locations.description:
**Location:** Floating above a wooden box that a cart is resting on.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

**Songs:**
- Daylight at the Grand Millewish Tree
- Night Whispers of the Grand Millewish Tree

locations.title: Stonecrown Records
locations.description:

**Location:** On some boxes on the northern side of the Silvergale statue Wishing Well lake.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 02

**Songs:**
- To the Pinnacle: Stonecrown!
- A Thousand Year Vigil
- Legends in the Wind
- Night of the Silvergale

locations.title: Brookwood Forest Records
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of some sandbags on the northwestern edge of the large platform.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

**Songs:**
- Every Minute, Every Second, Every Wish
- Every Hour, Every Instant, Every Whim
- Wishes Never Sleep

locations.title: First, the Foundation
locations.description:
**Location:** Sitting on a table, between a cloth shelter and a log tunnel.

**Album:** Stonewoods and the Silvergale - 03

locations.title: Fallen Wish Highlands Records
locations.description:
**Location:** Floating on a box in the southern part of the main square.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 02

**Songs:**
- Secret of the Bizarre Taste
- Traces of a Wish

locations.title: Grand Tree Residential Area Records
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Grand Tree Residential Area](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420627)

**Location:** On the top of some shelving furniture, east-southeast of the Residential Area square.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 01

**Songs:**
- Little Neighbors Among the Leaves
- Strolling Through the Shade
- Silently Sprouting Wishes

locations.title: Temple of Wishes Records
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Temple of Wishes](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420630)

**Location:** On the platform northeast of the [Temple of Wishes Warp Spire](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420630). Will be on the circular bench seat close to the walkway connecting it to the main Temple of Wishes platform.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 02

**Songs:**
- Sanctuary of Wishes
- To Wish for the Aurosa
- Stars and Wishes
- Long Scroll of Wishes

locations.title: Grand Tree Valley Records
locations.description:
**Location:** At a rock shrine under the Desperation Vine, somewhat hidden among the yellow Wish Bottles.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 01

**Songs:**
- Traces of Wishes in the Wind
- Stars and Our Reflections
- Where Do the Fireflies Go?

locations.title: Valley of Blossoms Records
locations.description:
**Location:** On the boxes with fireworks and balloons.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 02

**Songs:**
- A Splendid Celebration
- Vibrant Preparations
- May You Shine Like a Star
- The Birth of Innocence

locations.title: Valley of Blossoms South Records
locations.description:
**Location:** Floating next to the large rock heading south to the blue boulder.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 02

**Songs:**
- Breath of the Stars
- Returning to a Starry Night

locations.title: Swordsmith Ruins Records
locations.description:
**Location:** On a stone block on the upper level of the [Swordsmith Ruins Gate](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700).

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 02

**Songs:**
- Swordsmith Ruins
- A Night as Long as Rus

locations.title: Hidden Wishes
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Deep Swordsmith Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420703). After [the Intermediate Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=423208), head left into a new room. This music sheet will be floating on the rock you need to use to get into the Woven Pillars as Momo.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Welcome, Wishes!
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Wish Auditing Station](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=426366). From the entry door, head to the left-hand side of the room to find this in a short rack.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Guess the Perfume's Final Note!
locations.description:
**Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Auroma Extraction Room area. From [the second Whimstar](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=499085), jump off the nearby conveyor belt to find this on top of a green cylindrical object.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Fingertips Touching Dreams
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside [Timis's Beauty Lab](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123). From [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=499051), jump out a square hole in the ceiling to find a small room with a sloped conveyor belt. It's hard to spot, but this music sheet will be on top of one of the glass bottles at the bottom of the glass bottle wall.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: One Pump of Foundation, One Pump of Joy
locations.description:
**Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Cosmetic Assembly Line area. After going down the first conveyor belt tube, you'll find this on top of a large purple box directly ahead of you.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Blinking Jazzy Lashes
locations.description:
**Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Cleansing Oil Workshop area. From the checkpoint marker, head around the corner to a tiny door only Momo can fit through. Look to the left of it to spot a stack of glass bottles: it's hard to see, but this music sheet is on this stack!

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Garrison of the Paladins Records
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Garrison of the Paladins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420640)

**Location:** On some boxes, directly underneath the Confetti Cannon that shoots you to the very top of the tree.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 02

**Songs:**
- At Ease, Get Ready, and Go!
- Work Hard and Forge Ahead
- Eyes of the Night Watch
- Keeping Watch Through the Night

locations.title: Old Pages, New Chapters
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** [Rescue at the Wishball Field](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=499563)

**Tier:** [Temple of Wishes](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420630)

**Location:** Inside the Temple of Wishes, above a small pile of books in the library side-room. You can only access this once you complete "[Rescue at the Wishball Field](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=499563)".

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: A Sheathed Sword
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) opening area. At the first Iron Squirrel Guardian Statue, it will be floating on a wooden box to the left of the respawn point.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Tempered by Wind and Fire
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Ventilation Tunnel area. After passing through the wind tunnel, you'll emerge into a forge room. Check the boxes below the tunnel you used to get here to find this music sheet.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Eternal Dawn
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Sacred Corridor area. It will be sneakily hidden behind the large wooden crate, near [the pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=425029) visible from the checkpoint.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Echoes of the Forge
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Sacred Corridor area. From the checkpoint, check underneath it to find a metal pipe with Blings, which takes you to a side area with an Iron Squirrel. Behind it will be a metal structure, with this music sheet floating above the wooden boxes in the structure.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Immortal Through a Thousand Strikes
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Forge Tower area. After riding up the first set of fans, you'll land on a large wooden platform. Check the room at the base of the platform to find this music sheet in the back-left corner.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Endless Dawn
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Forge Tower area. It'll be in the same alcove as [this area's Whimstar](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=425027), in the back-right corner.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Long Time No See, Knight
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Sword Sanctuary area. It's very cleverly hidden in an alcove on the right-hand side of the hallway linking the checkpoint to the Heurta statue room.

**Album:** The Promise of the Aurosa and the Dawn: 03

locations.title: Elderwood Wharf Records
locations.description:
**Location:** On a box at the end of the pier.

**Album:** Songs of Spira

**Songs:**
- Traces in the Sand
- Strolling Through the Sands

locations.title: Nighttime Adventure
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of a covered stack of logs.

**Album:** Songs of Spira

locations.title: Follow the Light
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s Mirage Realm area. After using two spring mushrooms to get up a cliff, turn left and go through the small archway to find a room with a pool of water in the back. This music sheet will be among the mushrooms on the right-hand side.

**Album:** Secrets of Itzaland

locations.title: Dream of the Fireflies
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s opening area. From [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507490), take the right-hand path that stays flat and goes around a corner (if you take a path that immediately slopes downward, you took the wrong one!).

At the end you'll come across a third intersection with pink mushrooms in the middle. Here, check for a small tunnel and head down it: the music sheet will be floating on a large circular red fungi on the left-hand wall as you head down.

**Album:** Secrets of Itzaland

locations.title: Up in a Dream
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s Vein Ruins area, in the same room as [these three Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507500).

**Album:** Secrets of Itzaland

locations.title: Glory of Days Gone By
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s opening area. In the same spot at these three Dews, check behind the nearby box you can push with Gigantification. The music sheet will be behind it, near a fallen black pot.

**Album:** Secrets of Itzaland

locations.title: Silent Honor
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Corridor of Glory. After [the previous three Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507684), you'll go through a short pipe section and emerge in front of a huge wooden table. The music sheet will be on top of this table.

**Album:** Secrets of Itzaland

locations.title: After the Setting Sun
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Hidden Corridor. In the room the Behemoth falls down, floating atop a tall thin bookcase next to the brass cauldron in the middle of the room.

**Album:** After the Setting Sun

locations.title: Ruin and Demise
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Corridor of Glory. In the huge room with the Titan King statue, climb up the statue using the tassels with Blings. As you climb up, look on top of the broken column to the right of the statue to spot this music sheet floating above it.

**Album:** Secrets of Itzaland

locations.title: Home of the Saintess
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Home of the Saintess](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508521). Will be floating against the right-hand wall when you enter.

**Album:** Elderwood Echoes
