**Location:** Inside the partially-submerged train car. Use the updraft bulb on the western end, then drop down the hatch on the eastern end. Exit by purifying the Esseling to lower the chain wall.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Reward for completing [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421026).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Reward for completing [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421030).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** Choo-Choo Station 3F

**Type:** Cursed Chest

**Location:** Inside the Advanced Chest near the edge of the cliff. Open it and defeat the Esselings to reveal the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfly

**Location:** Use a Shrinking Outfit to climb up the Woven Pillar as Momo and reach a high platform up a tree, then switch back to Nikki to catch the Whimfly using a Bug-Catching Outfit.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Floating very, *VERY* high up in the air. To reach this, Shrink down to Momo and bounce up the trampolines around the tree trunk (Momo bounces up higher than Nikki can).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Star Search

**Location:** The Whimstar will be on the roof of Abibo's house at the very top of this structure. The star-shaped object will be on their platform, and is a star-shaped plinth with a white orb atop it (there are three others next to it, but they have circular plinths.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** On top of one of the hanging thuddy squash jail cells. Can be reached by Floral Gliding from the watchtower with the [Advanced Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421072) in it.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 3F

**Type:** Star Search

**Location:** Locate this as one of the yellow stars in the bottom-left corner of the mural.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimflutter

**Location:** Catch the Whimflutter floating at the top of the watchtower.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Type:** Cursed Chest

**Location:** At the base of the short cliff. Open the chest and defeat the enemies it spawns to reveal the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin "[Go to the Dream Warehouse!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=456872)"

**Location:** In the [Dream Warehouse](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=417462) Back Window area. From [these Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419791), get on top of the structure, then jump across the origami crane and drop into the room. The Whimstar will be there.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Cursed Chest

**Location:** Inside the Advanced Chest sitting on the rocky platform.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Floating above the giant water wheel. To get this, ride up the water wheel and then jump off it.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** At the edge of the cliff. To get up here, approach from the south as Momo, navigate around the Punceria plants, then climb up the Woven Pillar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Floating very high above a log. To grab this, climb to the top of the Ascetic Camp's tree stump, letting you glide to the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfin

**Location:** Catch the Whimfin in the water

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Grand Tree Residential Area](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420627)

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** On a platform directly underneath the Residential Area. The spot to access this is a Woven Pillar on the northern side, behind all the raised platforms.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 1F

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** On the same level as the nearby [Catapult Seal](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=425548). Hiding under a pile of leaves.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Reward for completing [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421823).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** Located high in the air above a blue bounce bulb. Reach here either by using the [Catapult Seal](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=417528)  to the south (don't feed it or else you'll go too far), or Floral Gliding from the [Volunteer Corps Watchtower area](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419513).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 2F

**Location:** Inside the cluster of hay bales across from the [Volunteer Corps Watchtower Warp Spire](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419513).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimmink

**Location:** Groom the Whimink!

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Reward for completing the [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421859).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Reward for completing [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421875).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** In [Stonecrown Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421879), at the very top where the exit is.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Under a breakable ground section. At the top of the stonetree are the rocks you need to push down to break the wall.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stellar Fishing Ground 2F

**Type:** Whimstar Chase

**Location:** On top of the Stonetree, hidden inside a breakable box.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimmink

**Location:** Groom the Whimink at the edge of the cliff.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Reward for completing the [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421895).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stellar Fishing Ground 1F

**Type:** Star Search

**Location:** The star is in the Piecey mural, a faint star shape above the lily pads in the bottom-right corner of the mural.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** In the side-area of the [Stellar Fishing Ground Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421908). You can reach it by jumping up the ledges where the [two Dews of Inspiration](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421904) are.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Reward for completing [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421915).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Cursed Chest

**Location:** Inside the [Small Stonetree Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419868). Specifically in a Cursed Chest in the room to the right of the green chair room. Will be on top of a covered box.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** On the dock at the bottom of the stonetree.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimstar Chase

**Location:** Inside a smashable box on a ledge under a tree.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimmink

**Location:** Groom the Whimink at the edge of the cliff.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfly

**Location:** A Whimfly fluttering around the top of this cliff.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** To get this, head for the short rock ledge northwest of here where the smashable crates are. Shrink down to Momo, then slip past the left-hand side of the crates into the tunnel. The Whimstar will be at the end.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Stylist's Guild Memorial](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=505769). To the right of the monument with [the previous Whimstar](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422131), located under a smashable pallet.

**Note:** After version 1.5, this Whimstar is collected in the Land with No Name where the "[Beyond the World's Boundaries](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=505772)" Main Quest takes place.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Stylist's Guild Memorial](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=505769). Will be under the small circular monument near the stairs leading to the exit / entrance of the Memorial.

**Note:** After version 1.5, this Whimstar is collected in the Land with No Name where the "[Beyond the World's Boundaries](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=505772)" Main Quest takes place.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Stylist's Guild Memorial](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=505769). When you reach the fallen cabinet, the game directs you to the first Whimstar in the room behind you.

**Note:** After version 1.5, this Whimstar is collected in the Land with No Name where the "[Beyond the World's Boundaries](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=505772)" Main Quest takes place.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the tree trunk. To get in, Shrink to Momo and goad the nearby Punceria plant to make it attack the ground near the trampolines, then ride it up as a platform. You can then use the trampolines to get into the tree trunk with the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfly

**Location:** Floating around the blue Starlink Stone.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Cursed Chest

**Location:** Inside the Cursed Advanced Chest on the clearing overlooking the waterfall.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfly

**Location:** Fluttering around the tops of the highest structures here.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the back of this ruin. To safely get it, keep an eye on the Iron Squirrel Guardian Statue so that it's not looking at you as you head up. You can also jump in through a Momo-sized hole in the wall if you can manage it!

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** Off the side of the road, close to the intersection.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** On the edge of the cliff overlooking the river.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimmink

**Location:** Sitting atop the ledge overlooking the river.

locations.title: Wimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfin

**Location:** Fish this from the fishing spot at the eastern end of the lily pad platforms.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** On top of the building on this platform. To get here, climb up the tall tree stump to the west by using the Punceria plant as a platform.

From there you can glide to the platform as Nikki, then use another Punceria plant as a platform to get on top of the building (alternatively, you can use a branch behind the building to get up it as Nikki).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** On top of the tree stump. To reach this, shrink down to Momo and use the trampoline to the south.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** Floating on the end of a log resting on a small rock. This is a rather tricky Whimstar that requires you to climb up several Woven Pillars to pick up some Little Whimstars along the way.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Floating up the large tree. To get here, climb up to the tallest tower of the building, then glide to the tree's branches and jump around them.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfly

**Location:** Fluttering high above a Spring Leaf.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** Hiding under some rocks. You'll need to shrink down to Momo to reach all of the Little Whimstars, whilst also avoiding the Punceria plants (which you can do by switching back to Nikki).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof of the mill tower. To get up here, you'll need to glide onto a tall platform to the northwest by jumping from the tree stump with [a trio of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422317) on top.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** At the end of a log tunnel that starts to the east of the Whimstar's location.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimflutter

**Location:** Flying around the top of the large tree stump. Get on top of the stump by jumping and gliding off a ledge just uphill.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** To get this, fast travel to the [Barrel Home Warp Spire](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419372) and activate [Little Apron Gulpetta's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=424703) Gliding Station. The Whimstar will be floating below on your right partway down the glide, and above a giant wind bulb.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** On the roof of the [Ruins of the Guardians](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420701). After climbing up here, locate a wooden platform you can use to get on top of a wall so you can glide over to it.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** Floating right next to the path.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Reward for completing the [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422298).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfly

**Location:** Fluttering around the corner of the balcony.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** Next to the path, east of the collapsed bridge that leads to the [Swordsmith Ruins Gate](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** At the second Iron Squirrel Guardian Statue, behind a low wall. You'll need to sneak past as Momo to hide behind the stone object where the Whimstar is and avoid getting caught.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** Floating above a small rock close to the river.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Cursed Chest

**Location:** Inside the Cursed Advanced Chest sitting on the rocky ledge. Defeat all the Esselings that appear when you open it to reveal the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside [Deep Aurosa Valley Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421809). After crossing the chasm with water at the bottom, take the left-hand path to find this Whimstar at the end of the tunnel.

You can use the boulders at the start of the tunnel to break down the wall, making a shortcut back to the Cavern's entrance.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Reward for completing the [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422705).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Reward for completing the [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422706).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** On a cloud next to the path.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Deep Swordsmith Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420703). From [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=423206), continue along the Woven Pillars to reach the ledge with this Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfin

**Location:** Fish out of the water near the waterfall.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Type:** Cursed Chest

**Location:** By the tents. Open and defeat the Esselings to reveal the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Market of Mirth Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=417446). From [the previous Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=426402), kill the Jelly Pouch to release a vent bulb. Ride it up and jump across the gap to find the chest.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Market of Mirth Entrance Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420934). In the vertical wind shaft, locate the middle tunnel blocked by wooden crates you can smash. Head inside and jump across the wooden platforms to find the Whimstar at the end.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Estate Roadside Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419516).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 2F

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Hidden underneath a cracked part of the ground. Break through to this by pushing a boulder off the ledge above it.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** On top of the tree stump.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** On top of a tall flower post. Shrink down to Momo and climb up the Woven Pillars to get on top.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** On top of the tall chimney in the middle of the town square. To get this, first shrink to Momo and use the Spring Leaf on the northern edge of the town square to bounce up to a platform with a [Confetti Cannon](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497949). Use it to fire into the Whimstar!

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Cursed Chest

**Location:** Inside this Advanced Chest, which spawns many Esselings when you open it. Defeat them to reveal the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Temple of Wishes](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420630)

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside a tunnel on the side of the building. Get in by plunging the smashable crate as Nikki, then shrinking to Momo to get into the tunnel.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimmink

**Location:** Approach and groom the Whimmink at the top of the small cliff.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whim Chase

**Location:** Inside the [Outer Swordsmith Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420697). In the very first room, inside one of the smashable crates.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** On the northern tip of the island river.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Forge Tower area. As you climb up, you'll eventually come to a tall alcove in a part of the tower lit by sunlight (this will be directly below the Sword Sanctuary checkpoint at the top). The Whimstar is high up in the "mouth" of the alcove, and reachable with one of the fans.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Sacred Corridor area. From the checkpoint, head forward and around the corner. Head to the ledge of the pit in the hallway, then look down to spot this Whimstar at the bottom by the water. You can ride up the fan as Momo to get back up.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Ventilation Tunnel area. After going through the wind tunnel, you'll emerge into a sword forge room. Before exploring it, check above the entry pipe to spot a hole you can jump up to as Nikki. The Whimstar will be in here on your left.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Sacred Corridor area. From the [Echoes of the Forge record](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=500068), get on top of the metal structure by riding up the fan as Momo. Here you'll find some smashable boxes: smash them with Nikki's Plunge to reveal this Whimstar behind them.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Temple of Wishes](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420630)

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** On a platform directly below the one where the [Temple of Wishes Records](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=496703) is. You can get down here by dropping off the edge behind Dorobo's restaurant reception, then using the trampoline to help glide over to the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Begin "[Go to the Dream Warehouse!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=456872)"

**Location:** In the [Dream Warehouse](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=417462) After the Corner area. After the two sets of origami crane platforms, you'll be on a platform with a huge gash in the middle. From here, just left up the long curved series of origami crane platforms and ride a platform up to the top of the tower. The Whimstar is at the very top of the tower.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438). After arriving at the room with the water channel cutting through it, jump up the barrel in the back-left corner to go through a doorway. In this new room will be the Whimstar, guarded by two Esselings.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Normal

**Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438)'s Transport Path. On the first mine cart track, jump off to the right to a tunnel where an Esseling is, then head around the corner and into a room. The Whimstar will be on the left across the gap.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438)'s Reserve Vault section. At the end of the large room with the lines of moving barrels, ride the last line right through a tunnel guarded by an Esseling. Follow this path to the platform at the end guarded by two Esselings to find the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Ripple Wine Cellar Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=432438)'s Reserve Vault section. In the final room with the large rolling barrels, head to the front-right corner to find an archway leading into a tunnel. At the end of this tunnel will be the Whimstar, guarded by an Esseling.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: Inside [Ripple Estate Cliffside Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419937). From the entrance, ride up the wind vent to an upper area, then head down the left-hand tunnel. Continue veering left past some Esselings, and you'll find the Whimstar at the dead end.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the first room of the Broken Hallway section. Here, cross over the rotating column, then go right across the gap. Defeat the Esselings here, then drop down the square hole on the left-hand side. Turn right to spot this inside the tunnel!

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the Palace Old Courtyard area. From the central violin statue, turn left to find a ruined building. Climb up to the very top it via the columns on the left-hand side, then drop inside to the bottom. Smash the stack of breakable boxes here to get the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Palace Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=435963), in the Doll Gallery area. From the checkpoint marker, jump forward across the gaps to the clockwork guard, then drop left onto a walkway. Follow it to a platforming section with the Whimstar in a glass case: jump up the square red columns to get up, then ground pound through the glass to get the Whimstar!

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Palace Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=436014), around the corner after the first rolling column.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: Reward for completing curio domain

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=450472).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Stoneville Outskirts Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419500). At the room with lots of Esselings, look left for a hole you can dive down with a single Esseling at the bottom. The Whimstar will be down here.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Karst Cave of Blue Tears area. After running across a sandy path at water level, you'll jump up some ledges to find some wooden walls. Use the catapult's boulders to destroy these walls, revealing a path up through some Esselings to the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' opening area. From [these Dews of Inspiration](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464351), continue across to a ledge on the cave wall, then turn left to spot these Dews on a ledge below the catapult.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Cliffside Walkway area. At the top of the climbing section, it'll be on top of some hanging beams of wood. Climb up some nearby platforms to get up to it.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Serpentine Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=464342)' Ancient Pool Ruins area. From the checkpoint post, turn left to a small pool area and jump up on top of the largest rock column. Here, turn left to find the Whimstar on a ledge.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Choo-Choo Station Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419515). In the second Floral Gliding section you'll come across an island filled with Esselings. Defeat them to release an updraft bulb that takes you to the upper floor. Ahead on the right will be this Whimstar, in front of a wall of vines.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Heavy-Duty Flatbed area. After reaching this checkpoint, head forward across the next car and climb up the wall. At the top, turn around to spot this Whimstar atop one of the structures on the car you just went across. You can reach this by going across the wooden platform patrolled by a ghost.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Heavy-Duty Flatbed area. After [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=495077), continue forward to the next ghost pop-up jumpscare: the Whimstar is in a second of the structure the ghost pop-up slides out of.

If you're having trouble getting in here, return to where [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=495077) were and Floral Glide onto this structure.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Ghost Train's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419499) Shipping Boxcar area. Early on you'll be running along train car rooftops whilst dodging fiery beams. When you get to the third car, Plunge on the wooden panel to find this Whimstar in the small room.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Prosperville Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421945), at the end of the path that loops back to the beginning.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Volunteer Corps Camp Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419514). After the previous pair of Dews, continue forward until you come to a split in the path. Head left here across the water and up the ramp to find this Whimstar at the dead-end.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfish

**Location:** At the western pool just before Lupabo's spot. Fish out of the water to get this.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Inspection Center Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420082). After the previous pair of Dews, you'll come across an open space with three crates on the back wall. Move one of the crates under the lower ledge on the left-hand wall so that you can climb up to the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Waterfall Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421602). From [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497686), jump up the ledges to defeat the Esselings, continue across the rock bridge, defeat some Esselings across a gap.

In the next room is a Punceria plant: to get to the Whimstar above it, switch to Momo and have it attack the ground below the Woven Pillar. Jump onto it and ride it up, giving you enough height to reach the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Farm Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422322). After using the first two trampolines in the second waterlogged chasm, turn around to spot a third: bounce on it at Momo to reach a Woven Pillar on the wall that takes you to this Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside [Timis's Beauty Lab](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123). From the previous pair of Dews, jump out a square hole in the ceiling to find a small room with a sloped conveyor belt. Use it to get this Whimstar atop the pile of glass bottles.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Auroma Extraction Room area. From [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=499083), run up and jump off the conveyor belt to climb up the high wall. The Whimstar will be up here.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** In [Timis's Beauty Lab's](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420123) Cosmetic Assembly Line area. From [the previous pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=499100), locate the large purple perfume box and use it to jump up to an upper hallway. This Whimstar will be at the end of the hallway.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Temple of Wishes](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420630)

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** On top of the Temple of Wishes building. You can get up here by using a Confetti Cannon. It's easier to shoot Momo to the next Cannon, then turn right and glide Nikki over to the rooftop.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Temple of Wishes](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420630)

**Location:** Atop the northern-most spectator tower at the Wishball field.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Swordsmith Ruins'](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420700) Sword Courtyard area. When you go through a low hole in the wall as Momo, look left to spot a pipe you can go through not marked with Blings. Head through here and ride up the fan to get to a ledge with this Whimstar on it!

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: Reward for completing the Curio Domain

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Collect Whim

**Location:** Floating at the top of the short waterfall.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Whoosh-way](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507267), on the ceiling of a loop-de-loop about two-thirds into the course.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Cursed Chest

**Location:** Inside the Advanced Chest: open it and defeat the Esselings that appear to reveal the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Normal

**Location:** At the dirt intersection inside the Snail Ranch area. Only appears after progressing "[New Beginnings in Itzaland](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=504211)".

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimflutter

**Location:** Flying at the tops of the trees. You can get up here by jumping on from the cliffs to the east.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s opening area. At the first intersection will be a trio of pink mushrooms, with this Whimstar high above. You can grab it by using Gigantification.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s Mirage Realm area. After using two spring mushrooms to get up a cliff, head right and jump across the gap. Instead of using the next spring mushroom, head left down a side-tunnel. Defeat the Esselings as you go (if they're present) to find the Whimstar across the gap at the end.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s Vein Ruins area. When you get to the fifth green mushroom, look down the tunnel to spot a high entry point on the right hand wall. To get up there, use Gigantification, then jump twice to switch to Bubble Gliding, allowing Nikki to enter.

Quickly defeat the Esselings (or ignore them) and get to the end of this corridor to find another green mushroom. Step on it as Giant Nikki to both make a safe zone, and collect this Whimstar!

An alternative method of getting here is to get to the seventh green mushroom, turn around, then go down the walkway on the right-hand side and drop down the hole, landing directly on the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Corridor of Glory. In the huge room with the Titan King statue, climb up the statue using the tassels with Blings on them to find this Whimstar near her face.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Hidden Corridor. In the room the Behemoth falls down, floating high above the brass cauldron in the middle of the room.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Hidden Corridor. On the third floor of the "Behemoth Elevator", head for the second side-area with the horn among trees and sunlight. The Whimstar will be here, behind the horn.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimflutter

**Location:** Fluttering around the top of this tree stump.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). From [the previous Primary Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507773), continue through the nearby hole in the wall to find a huge room with many enemies inside. Defeat them, then use Gigantification to smash the Giant Crates to find a side-room with this Whimstar in it.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 1F

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** At the [1F Transfer Station](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508477), on the rooftop directly above the door that goes back to [the Snail Ranch](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=505487).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 2F

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** On top of the elevator connecting Spira 1F and 2F. You can reach this (albeit with some difficulty) by standing on top of the elevator cab, then jumping up onto the rope spool the Whimstar is floating above.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Champion Exhibition Hall. From [the previous Lore Item](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507715), head right into a hallway with very little floor left with orange-leaved vines in it. Here, turn right to spot a hole you can jump through into a side-area.

In here, locate some large wooden boxes that you can use to access a side-area with turning gears. The Whimstar will be on the farthest of the three.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Vault Bottom area. In the section with the wooden Sticky Claw fans, when you get to the third wooden fan, drop down over the other side of the pink wall. There, look left to spot this Whimstar in the doorway.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Vault Mid-Level Exhibition Rotunda area. When you get to the jump leading to a doorway out of the rotunda area, look left to spot another walkway. Head along it to the end, then look up and ahead to spot a Sticky Claw panel that get you to this Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Jar Storage Room area. From the checkpoint, jump down the left-hand side of the bridge to the lower area, then look left to spot two sets of shelves in the wall. In the left-hand one is an orange Sticky Claw panel leading to a side-room.

In the side-room, jump over the wall of alarm bell strings using either the chests on the floor or the Sticky Claw panel on the ceiling, letting you get to the Whimstar on the cabinet.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Vault Internal Transport Passage area. From [the previous Lore Item](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508564), look right to spot this Whimstar floating over the edge of the wooden balcony.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** Spira 3F

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside [the Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508604).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** High above the [Coliseum Main Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673). To get here, head for the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508934) to the northwest and then go southwest. You'll need to run along a large vine in order to get in reach of the Whimstar!

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Cursed Chest

**Location:** Inside a Cursed Advanced Chest. Open this, then defeat all the Esselings to reveal the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Spira's Shelldome](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042)

**Type:** Targeting Whim

**Location:** At the very top of Spira's Shelldome. Get up here, and to the Whimstar itself, using the Sticky Claw ability. This one is particularly tricky, and may require the Heart of Infinity ability that allows Nikki to hover when aiming in mid-air (in the Archery: Basic branch).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Spira's Shelldome](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042)

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** At the tip of the spear piercing out of the Spira Shelldome. To get up here, you'll need to use the Sticky Claw ability to grapple up using Adventurer Bees.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Inside the [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509068).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimmink

**Location:** Groom the Whimmink overlooking the river fork.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Inside the [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509106).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Floating at the top of the Snail Clinic building.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimstar Chase

**Location:** Inside a wooden box you can smash with a plunge. After breaking it, you'll have to chase down the Whimstar as it flies around the river.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Inside the [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509800).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Targeting Whim

**Location:** Floating at the top of the small waterfall.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** Floating at the shoreline of the river in plain view.

Annoyingly this Whimstar cannot be collected until you complete "[Breaking News! Sports Superstar Gone Missing!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508927)", as the cloud floats past its starting point and forces the camera to it, preventing you from collecting one of the Little Whimstars.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimstar Chse

**Location:** Inside a smashable wooden box. Chase it down to collect it!

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Up in the treetops. You can get up here by using the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509813).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimmink

**Location:** Groom the Whimmink on top of the rocks.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Collect Whim

**Location:** In the center of the ruins.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification during "[Beware of the Behemoth!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507478)".

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the pile of leaves, which can only be cleared away using Gigantification.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Targeting Whim

**Location:** Floating at the top of the branch structure above the campfire.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfin

**Location:** Caught at the [Fishing Spot](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509824).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** Inside the [Shroomling Pool](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509826). It'll be at the base of the curved wall that gets you up onto the ceiling.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Floating partway up the waterfall. You can reach this either by dropping down from above, or by jumping up the snails to the east of it.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Trails of Whim

**Location:** An invisible Whimstar flying around the tree tops. Shoot it with Archery while it's leaving a visible trail to enable collecting it.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Inside the [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509837).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Up in the tree tops. You can get here (barely) by using the top of the tent where [this pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509839) are.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Trails of Whim

**Location:** An invisible Whimstar that periodically leaves a trail as it flies around. Shoot it with Archery to halt it so you can collect it.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Curio Domain

**Location:** Inside the [Curio Domain](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509845).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimflutter

**Location:** Fluttering around the end of a log with pink mushrooms on the end.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Up in the tree tops. You can get up here by gliding to [this Dew](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509794) from the roof of the Snail Clinic.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Targeting Whim

**Location:** Up in the tree tops. You can get up here by gliding to [this Dew](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509794) from the roof of the Snail Clinic.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** Up in the tree tops. You can get up here by gliding to [this Dew](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509794) from the roof of the Snail Clinic.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimflutter

**Location:** Fluttering up in the tree tops. You can get up here by using [this Titan's Super Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=510155).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Cursed Chest

**Location:** Inside a Cursed Chest at the edge of the cliff.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Trails of Whim

**Location:** Flying around the tops of a tree at this spot. You can get up here by gliding from the cliffs to the north of here.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Worm Hole Whimstar

**Location:** Inside a worm hole. To reveal this, use Gigantification to move the three giant snails over the holes. Then, stand on top of a remaining hole and wait until the Whimstar pops out of the final uncovered hole.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Up in the tree tops. You can get up here by gliding from the cliffs to the west of this spot.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Star Search

**Location:** The starting point will be on the top point of this building. The star shape you're looking for will be on top of the red awning on the southern side of the building.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Sky Monarch

**Location:** Floating incredibly high up in the air. Reach this by using the [Sky Monarch](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509872) that nests to the northeast.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Sky Monarch

**Location:** Floating above the water. To get here, you'll need to use [this Sky Monarch](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509951).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification during "[Beware of the Behemoth!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507478)".

**Type:** Whimstar Chase

**Location:** Inside a smashable box nestled between some rocks. You will need to use Gigantification in order to catch this one.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Collect Whim

**Location:** Floating above some rocks on the western riverbank.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfin

**Location:** Fish out from the [Fishing Spot](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=513445).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfin

**Location:** Fish in the pond to get the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** On the nose of the large dragon skull.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the ribcage of the dragon skeleton. Reachable from below with Gigantification, or by jumping down from above.

Apologies about the screenshot, we accidentally collected it before taking the picture.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** On the spine laid across the lake. Follow the trail and collect the Whimstar at the end.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Collect Whimstar

**Location:** Floating high above the ground. Can be reached using Gigantification, or by climbing the nearby structure to reach.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimfin

**Location:** South east of the dock. Across the water from Shell Island.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whim Chase

**Location:** Inside a smashable wooden box on this platform. You can get here by gliding from the tree platforms to the southwest.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimflutter

**Location:** Fluttering around the highest platform on this tree.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification during "[Beware of the Behemoth!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507478)".

**Type:** Whim Chase

**Location:** Use the [Titan's Super Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=513429) and trampoline to get to the Whimstar in the crate on the walkway encircling the tree. During the chase, use Gigantification to make catching this easier.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Trails of Whim

**Location:** "Invisible" Whimstar circling the path.  Shoot the star with your purification outfit to collect.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Targeting Whim

**Location:** Floating above the grass. You can reach this without Gigantification if you Glide from the tall plant nearby with the big red leaves.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** At the very top of the crystal mountain peak.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** On top of the [Dazzling Plant Collectibles](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=510134) store's awning.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification during "[Beware of the Behemoth!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507478)".

**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the rolled up Blocking Fern up the ledge. Defeat the nearby Esselings, then unfurl the Blocking Fern with Gigantification.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification's Dash during "[The Unveiling](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507725)".

**Type:** Whimstar Chase

**Location:** Inside the smashable box that's glowing pink. Practically requires Gigantification to catch.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In [Sugarbloom Isle](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508546)'s Cabinet Corridor area. When you get to the top of the corridor where the yellow teleport doorway is, turn around to spot this Whimstar on the distant wall. Use Sticky Claw to pull out to two drawers on the left-hand wall so you can jump across them to the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In [Sugarbloom Isle](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508546)'s Sugar Walkway area. Just before jumping onto the set of three round tables, look left to spot a column with a table floating next to it, with this Whimstar at the top.

To get up here, use the Sticky Claw on the nearby sugar jar at the right time to reveal a platform next to the column. Jump up here to find another, hidden sugar jaw: Sticky Claw it to reveal more platforms that help you get up to the Whimstar!

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In [Sugarbloom Isle](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508546)'s Flip Hall area. After using the Sticky Claw on some ceiling tables to cross a huge gap, you'll land in a corner of the corridor. Around the corner on the left-hand wall is an upside-down cabinet with the Whimstar floating next to it.

To get here, wait for a sliding table on the ceiling to pass by it on its way towards you. Sticky Claw a drawer of the cabinet, then Sticky Claw up onto the table. You can then glide from there to land on the cabinet drawer and get the Whimstar!

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

From [the previous Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=932798), ride up the Mechanical Arm nearby to the top of the central tower. There among the pile of cheese will be the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Fullbloom Celebration](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=930623)'s Celebration Prelude area. At the third cheese coaster stop, jump right into tall opening in the wall where a Mechwarden patrols. Infuse the Dish Mechanical Arm with Motive Power from the Mechwarden to reach the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Fullbloom Celebration](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=930623)'s Celebration Prelude area.When you get to the end of the cheese flume section where you're being bounced up into the air by pink water, the Whimstar will be above the center of the water plume.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Fullbloom Celebration](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=930623)'s Celebration Prelude area. When you ride the cheesecake factory's third Mechanical Arm, this will be ahead on top of the big brass machine in the middle of the room.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Fullbloom Celebration](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=930623)'s Celebration Prelude area. From [the previous three Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=932888), continue to the end of this side area to find this Whimstar up on the ledge.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:

**Location:** Above the stone blocks on the corner of this tiny island.

locations.description:

**Type:** Star Search

**Location:** In the gold dish on top of the large table. The star is *very* cleverly hidden as a gold Fidis coin, which is sitting in the exact middle of a beige rug with a red diamond in the middle.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:

**Location:** Groom the Whimink on the tower rooftop.

**Type:** Fleeing Whimstar

**Location:** Under the rooftop of this building.

**Location:** Under the roof of this building, among the pillars.

locations.title: Whimstar

locations.description:

**Type:** Star Search

**Location:** The star is a tiny star of the cake on the nearby table.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Golden Court Bridge Maintenance Passage](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=931441). It will be under the Aegis Wingbeast statue at the halfway point: Infuse it with three Motive Power to reveal it.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Sol Gate Maintenance Passage](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=930997), floating above the giant cogwheel.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Spira Waterfall Cliff Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=918111). After using the Sticky Claw to zip up onto the ledges overlooking the river, turn left to spot a left pile: destroy it with Gigantification Rush to reveal the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Coliseum Quarry Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936197). From [the previous Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936216), continue climbing up the wooden structure until you can jump off onto the planks of wood hanging from the crane. The Whimstar will be on the end of it.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Mothershroom Woods Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509094). After getting out of the large lake room, this will be on a ledge on your left.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Whimflutter

**Location:** Inside the [Luminous Pool Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509074). From [the previous two Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936565), continue up the path to get back to the lake room: the Whimflutter will be hear fluttering at the end of the path.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification's Dash during "[The Unveiling](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507725)".

**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** Inside the [Ruins Near Elderwood Shade](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542614). In the same area as the previous Dews is an opening in the left-hand wall that leads to this Whimstar. You will need to use Gigantification Roar to get the Little Big Whimstar under the blue Cheer-Up Bloom.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Little Big Whimstar

**Location:** Inside the [Titan's Workshop Warehouse Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542612). From [this chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936740), use the nearby Spring Leaf to climb up to the higher ledges of the rock wall, then head left and up the wooden stairs. At the top, head past the big red box, tree root and yellow tree to find this Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** In the [Healing Ground North Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937566). After [the previous chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937577), move one of the Dragonbones into the nearby sticky spot so you can jump across and collect this.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Targeting Whim

**Location:** Inside the [Dragon's Lair Peak Waterfall Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937567). In the opening pool area, use the Zephyr Vent geyser to reach an upper area with this Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Shore Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937568). After moving the Dragonbone to unblock the way forward, you'll arrive in an area with two Zephyr Vent geysers. Block the left-hand vent with the Dragon Bone to force the right-hand vent to eject the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Dragonbone Lumies

**Location:** Inside the [Shore Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937568). In the same room as the previous three Dews, locate the Dragonbone in the back-right corner of the room and use Dragonbone Mastery to stick all the nearby Lumies to it, revealing the Whimstar.

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Standard

**Location:** Inside the [Hall of Return](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=563385), behind [the Dragonbone Puzzle](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937758).

locations.title: Whimstar
locations.description:
**Type:** Dragonbone Shake

**Location:** Inside the [Hall of Return](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=563385). Head to about the "4:00" position to find the library area. Climb up to the top of the stone building here to find the Dragonbone holding this Whimstar.

locations.title: Greedy Pouch
locations.description: Greedy Pouch is a type of Esseling that drops a lot of Bling when killed.
