locations.description: **Location:** At the end of the climb around the base of the stonetree. After going along a set of wooden platforms at the side of the cliff, you'll reach a spot where there's a purple chained wall at the entrance to a small cave on the right. To get this inside, climb up a few more platforms, defeat the Esselings, then drop down from above.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 2F

**Location:** At the southern edge of the [Volunteer Corps Watchtower](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419513) area. Will be in a small hidden alcove at the edge of the cliff guarded by a single Esseling.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the ruined building. Unlock this by defeating all Esselengs atop this stonetree.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 2F

**Location:** On top of the small stonetree overlooking the circular structure, close to the [Stonecrown Entrance Warp Spire](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420743).

**Additional Reward:**[Competition](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421833) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Tier:** Stonecrown 2F

**Location:** At the top of a watchtower on the [Stonecrown Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420743) level. To get this, use the [Catapult Seal](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=417530) to get up to the [Volunteer Corps Watchtower](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419513) level. From here you can drop down onto the watchtower with this Chest.

**Additional Reward:** [Flashing Alert](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421836)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Stellar Fishing Ground Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421908)), cheekily hidden inside a tiny room behind the blue updraft bulb at the bottom of the cavern.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the Stonetree.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** On top of ruined wall. Climb up from the eastern end of the wall.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Stylist's Guild Memorial](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=505769). Will be at the balcony close to where the bookcase with "[Annual Report of the Florawish Stylist's Guild](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=456873)" is.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the large tree stump. To get up here, shrink to Momo, then goad the nearby Punceria plant into attacking the ground below the Woven Pillar. Jump on it and ride it up to reach the Woven Pillar and climb up to the top!

**Additional Reward:** [Calibration Time](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422148)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Sitting on a rock by the river. Defeat the Esselings to unlock it.

**Additional Reward:** [Red Essence](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422158) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Tier:** Prosperville 3F

**Location:** On a ledge of the southeastern part of the stonetree top.

**Additional Reward:** [Dark Night Sky](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422200) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** At the end of the [Volunteer Corps Camp Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419514). After using a Spring Leaf to bounce up to a higher rocky walkway, head to the far end of the walkway to find this Chest (defeating Esselings as you go!).

**Additional Reward:** [Mossy Hush](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=496076)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the tree where the [Timis's Beauty Lab Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497675) is. You can get up here by carefully walking up the green vine wrapping around it.

**Additional Reward:** [Feather Embrace](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422335) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On the top floor of the Ruins of the Guardians, hidden behind some breakable crates.

**Additional Reward:** [Elegant Steps](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422671) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside large log behind a little camp.

**Additional Reward:** [Defined Lines](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422697) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside [Deep Aurosa Valley Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421809). After crossing the chasm with water at the bottom, take the right-hand path to come to a dead-end with this Chest, guarded by a bunch of Esselings.

**Additional Reward:** [Midsummer Breeze](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497668)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside a tunnel on the southern side of the building. Get in by plunging the smashable crate as Nikki, then shrinking to Momo to get into the tunnel.

**Additional Reward:** [Scarlet Story](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422312) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Protected by a breakable wall, push the boulder from the tower downwards to break it down.

**Additional Reward:** [Uniform Companion](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422678) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Campsite Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=418470). From this [Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=423437), follow the Bling across the ledges to find this Advanced Chest on a grassy ledge.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On some rocky ledges, guarded by Esselings.

**Additional Reward:** [Gentle Curves](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=423628) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Guarded by Esselings near the waterfall. Defeat them to unlock this Chest.

**Contains:** [Bringing Flowers](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=423655) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the tree trunk: approach from the south and head through the root as Momo to reach this.

**Additional Reward:** [Neat Pleats](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=423666)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Ripple Estate Cliffside Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419937). From the entrance, head to the edge of the cliff, then glide right along the wall to find a hidden side area. Head inside and then left: defeat the two Esselings and jump across the platforms to get to the Chest!

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the tree stump holding up the platforms.

**Additional Reward:** [Brown Footprints](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421598) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** [Major Treetop Renovation!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=423633)

**Tier:** [Garrison of the Paladins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420640)

**Location:** On top of a spectator tower on the highest platform of the Millewish Tree.

**Additional Reward:** [Crisp Design](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=423853) (Sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Outer Swordsmith Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420697). In the upper-right area of the main room is a metal tube: shrink down to Momo and head up it. At the end is a cave room with this Chest, on a ledge guarded by Esselings.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Palace Ruins Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=436014). After jumping through the hole behind the glass cases, turn right and jump up the turning stone columns guarded by Esselings. The Advanced Chest will be at the top.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Choo-Choo Station Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419515). After crossing the first gap using a blue bounce bulb, Plunge through the wooden square in the ground to drop to a lower level. The Chest will be behind you, but you might want to defeat the Esselings first!

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Choo-Choo Station Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=419515), at the very top of the spiral stonetree that ends the cavern.

**Additional Reward:** [Summer Fragrance](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=494962)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Prosperville Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=421945). At the same pool with the first trio of Dews, turn around to spot a tiny room with this Chest inside, on the right.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Inspection Center Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=420082). After the previous pair of Dews, you'll come across an open space with three crates on the back wall. Move one of the crates to the right-hand wall so you can jump up to a new area with this Advanced Chest at the end. Defeat the Esselings to unlock it!

**Additional Reward:** [Herbal Aroma](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497068)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Farm Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422322). In the opening room, climb up the Woven Columns to reach a ledge with a tunnel and a box. Push the box down to the bottom and slide it under some Woven Pillars next to the entryway: they take you up to a ledge with this Advanced Chest on it.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Farm Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422322). From [the previous Intermediate Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=497711), return to the Woven Pillars and head left along the wall. You'll find this Advanced Chest on a ledge to the right of a waterfall.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Farm Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=422322). Will be under the large yellow tree at the end of the main path.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Hidden behind a fallen tree trunk at the base of the cliff.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Sitting on this spot at the highest level of the ruins. You'll need to climb up from the west in order to get here.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Mothershroom's Dream](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507508)'s Vein Ruins area. After crossing a body of water to the fourth green mushroom, look left for some mushrooms leading up to the top of a cliff. The Advanced Chest will be here, guarded by Esselings.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Between some wooden boxes, under the awning at the back of the Interim Stylist's Guild.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On this platform, accessible from the Shell Island Market.

**Additional Reward:** [Striped Socks](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507663) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507673)'s Corridor of Glory. In the huge Titan King statue room, check the floor behind the statue to find this, guarded by Esselings.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** High up on top of the wall. Get here by using the trampoline near the [Primary Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507732).

**Additional Reward:** [Wind-Swept Violet](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507735) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). This will be next to a lamp on the scaffolding up the walls of the room with the stack of crates in the middle.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). From the room with the stack of crates in the middle, head for the next area with the big desk guarded by Esselings. The Esselings will in fact be guarding this: defeat them to unlock the chest.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Docilism Secret Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507742). From [the previous three Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507779), continue to the sunlit room and locate the high ledge with a Spring Leaf on it. Use it to glide to a blue-lit alcove with this chest in it.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Shiny Vault](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508551)'s Jar Storage Room area. From [the previous three Primary Chests](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508602), locate the covered drawers in the back corner of the room you can use to get up on top of some drawers. Here, turn right and use the Sticky Claw ledge to get up to this Advanced Chest!

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Sitting on a rock formation, and guarded by many powerful Esselings.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Tucked between some boxes and the bottom of the stairs.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Tier:** [Spira's Shelldome](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509042)

**Location:** On one of the lower level's of Spira's Shelldome. Will be guarded by three quite powerful Esselings.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the log, which you can get into from the eastern side.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Shroomling Pool](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509826). Will be at the station at the end of the snail run, on a pile of boxes near a bowl of Sack Fruit.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** On top of a rock formation and guarded by Esselings. Defeat them to unlock this chest so you can open it.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification during "[Beware of the Behemoth!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507478)".

**Location:** Inside a small alcove at the bottom of the cliff. To access it, use Gigantification and move the giant snail out of the way.

**Additional Reward:** [Warm Memories](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509870) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** On top of this rock formation. Defeat the Esselings guarding it to unlock it!

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the Titan house.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On some boxes in a hidden room on the upper floor of the coliseum. Get up here using the [Titan's Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=510005).

**Additional Reward:** [Quiet Captivation](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=510012) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of this ledge. Is locked until you defeat the nearby [Paleleaf Wolfhead](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=510142).

**Additional Rewards:** Swirl Bubbles: Fresh x60

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the room unlocked in [Old Tears Shed Again: Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=508930). Apologies for the screenshot, we'd kinda already opened it.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On a wooden platform on the side of the giant stone spear: you can get here by climbing up the spear a little bit.

**Additional Reward:** [Restarted Steps](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=512561) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification's Dash during "[The Unveiling](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507725)".

**Location:** Dash into the cracked wall using Gigantification to break it. The chest will be in the alcove behind it.

**Additional Reward:** [Joy in Everything](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936170) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the wooden platform. Defeat the Esselings to unlock it.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Complete the pattern. (It's a heart!)

**Additional Rewards:**
- ??
- ??

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the ground floor hut.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On the rock in the water. Unlock this by defeating the nearby [Waterstride Wolfhead](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518020).

**Additional Rewards:**
- Swirl Bubbles: Sexy x160

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Finish the butterfly in the sand by tracing the right half of it with your footsteps.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Defeat of the Esselings inside the pink square to unlock this chest.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On a rock in the water where the ruined building is. Will be guarded by a Behemoth.

**Additional Reward:** [Critter Protector](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518038) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Atop some scaffolding in the basement of the house.

**Additional Reward:** [Bright Afternoon](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518028) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Hanging on a vine on the wall on the second floor of the house, guarded by three Esselings. Get up here using the [Titan's Super Bounce Board](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518031).

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Under the tail of the sleeping Behemoth.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the cave, next to the tent.

**Additional Reward:** [Pink-Brown Backpack](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518087) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Atop the rocky ledge. Defeat all the Esselings to unlock it.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On the wooden walkway up a tree. You can get here by using the Blocking Fern at the top of the cliff to the northwest: Gigantify, then Roar to lower it. You can then bounce along the trampolines to this Chest.

**Additional Reward:** [Lucky Shrooms](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=513432) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** A locked chest at the edge of the cliff. Unlock it by defeating the nearby [Forestshade Wolfhead](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=513580).

**Additional Rewards:**
- Swirl Bubbles: Sweet x160

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** Hanging from a vine under the big root going over the lake, and guarded by a Behemoth. Shoot it down with Archery to make it fall on the stone in the water.

**Additional Rewards:**
- [Cherished Collection](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=512995)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** On top of a small ledge to the north of the main path, and guarded by Esselings.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification during "[Beware of the Behemoth!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507478)".

**Location:** In a cave guarded by a sleeping Behemoth. It is possible to Roar at the Behemoth and stun it for just long enough to open the Chest.

**Additional Reward:** [Daily Company](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=513708) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** On this small island. To get here, follow the Gigantification Energy pickups and Blings to get here from the ribcage to the north of this island.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** At the southern coast of the island. Defeat the Esselings guarding it to unlock the chest and open it.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** In the shadow of the dragon skull skeleton. To unlock this, defeat the nearby [Curegrass Wolfhead](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=513614).

**Additional Rewards:**
- Oath of Frost (Companion Material)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Under a stack of smashable boxes near the wooden walkway.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Against the southern side of the wooden staircase.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On a wooden platform between the elevator shaft and the cliff. Is located partway-up the elevator shaft.

**Additional Reward:** [Night of Farewells](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518012) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** In the pink sand square. Unlock this by defeating the nearby Esselings.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification during "[Beware of the Behemoth!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507478)".

**Location:** Inside the [Coliseum Underground Drainage Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518821). It will be inside the tall red Blocking Fern on the central rock column ahead from the entrance. To get it, use Gigantification and push the fern down.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Coliseum Underground Drainage Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518821). From [these two Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518833), head right down the river, but keep an eye out on your right for a wooden platform leading to a side-area filled with smashable crates. Smash the crates with Plunge to reveal this Advanced Chest.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification during "[Beware of the Behemoth!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507478)".

**Location:** Inside the [Coliseum Underground Drainage Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=510216). From [the previous two Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518837), continue down the hallway and use Gigantification to smash the huge pile of crates, revealing a Titan's Super Bounce Board. To the right of it will be an alcove with this Chest in it.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Coliseum Underground Drainage Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=510214). From [the previous three Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518845), head around the ruined wall and jump down to the lower area where the Esselings are. Here, turn around to spot this Chest in a small alcove.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On the ground underneath the fungi platform with these two Dews.

**Additional Reward:** [Camping Life](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=518953) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of the huge vine, almost directly above [this Primary Chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542049).

**Additional Reward:** [Pride Tamer](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542051) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire the Sticky Claw ability by progressing "[The Snail-Shelled Shroomling Land](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507796)".

**Location:** In a basket up a large tree. To get up here, you'll need to use the Sticky Claw ability.

**Additional Reward:** [Heart Path](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542057) (sketch)

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** In the tall red Blocking Fern. Use Gigantification to push the fern down and open this chest.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the giant vine. Will be locked until you defeat the Esselings guarding it.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Tucked under a thick root, and guarded by four Esselings.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description: **Location:** Hanging high up the tree, hanging off the vine. While it's above a spring leaf and a trampoline, it's surprisingly tricky to shoot it down with Archery.

locations.title: Chest (Advanced)
locations.description:

Inside this room are three lanterns: two on either side of the bar where Yamimi is, and one hanging from the middle of the ceiling. Shoot these with Archery to reveal the Advanced Chest in front of the bar!

Drop down here and turn around to find this Chest in the small cave, guarded by a single Esseling.

To get back up to the octagonal arena, use Gigantification!

**Additional Reward:** Coocoo Copter Ticket x2

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Sol Gate Maintenance Passage](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=930997). After riding up an elevator platform, turn right to spot this on a box past a spinning cogwheel. Be careful of the Wayward Cogbud here!

**Additional Reward:** Coocoo Copter Ticket x2

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Sol Gate Maintenance Passage](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=930997). After crossing the long walkway with the two spinning cogwheels, turn left to spot a wall of smashable crates and some Frantic Shears behind it. Defeat it and open the chest!

**Additional Reward:** Coocoo Copter Ticket x2

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:

**Additional Reward:** Coocoo Copter Ticket x2

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:

**Additional Reward:** Coocoo Copter Ticket x2

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:

**Additional Reward:** Coocoo Copter Ticket x2

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:

**Additional Reward:** Coocoo Copter Ticket x2

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

**Additional Reward:** Coocoo Copter Ticket x2

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:

**Additional Reward:** Coocoo Copter Ticket x2

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:

As you go through the tunnels filled with cogwheels, after dropping down make sure to turn right to find this in a side-area hidden behind a large wooden crate. There's an Esseling in here though!

**Additional Reward:** Coocoo Copter Ticket x2

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside [Dragonrest Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=570830). On the uphill path, check the dark area to the left of the first Dragonbone to find this.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Spira Waterfall Cliff Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=918111). Will be at the bottom of the rock wall that you have to climb at the very start.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Spira Waterfall Cliff Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=918111). After using the Sticky Claw to zip up onto the ledges overlooking the river, jump across to the right-hand ledge and use Gigantification Rush to destroy the pile of leaves to reveal this chest.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Spira Waterfall Cliff Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=918111). From [the previous chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936192), check the dark area to the left of said chest (past the snail with the leafy shell) to find this at the base of the thick vine.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Coliseum Quarry Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936197). You can find this in the bottom of the of the quarry, inside a pile of glowing boulders you can smash with Gigantification Rush. It'll be guarded by some Esselings.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Coliseum Quarry Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936197). From [the previous chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936201), continue counter-clockwise around the bottom of the quarry to find a large wooden structure shaped like a box. Get on top and smash through the wooden panel with Gigantification, and you can find this chest in the back-left corner.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Coliseum Quarry Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936197). Return to [this pair of Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936199), then continue down the tunnel and around the corner. When you exit, head right and go up the stairs. Here near the Blings in the air will be this chest on top of a wooden structure with cloth on the top.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Coliseum Quarry Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936197). From [the previous three Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936218), return to the Titan's Bounce Board and use it to launch up the rock wall. This chest will be on top.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Mothershroom Woods Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509094). Will be in an alcove at the bottom of the cliff where the previous two Dews were.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Mothershroom Woods Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509094). In the first large lake room, check the back-right area where the Esselings are to spot this hanging from a vine. Shoot it down with Archery!

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Mothershroom Woods Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509094). In the second large lake room, this will be cheekily hidden on a fungi platform on the rear side of the smaller rock column in the back of the room.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Mothershroom Woods Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509094). In the same side-room as these three Dews, these will be hidden in the dark under a tall mushroom on the back wall.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Luminous Pool Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509074). From [these two Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936534), head right and jump up the grassy ledges guarded by Esselings. To the left of the final ledge will be this Chest on the right-hand wall.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Luminous Pool Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509074). From [the previous chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936557), jump back to the previous ledge and head forward and left around the corner. You'll find this chest here against the central rock column.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Luminous Pool Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509074), at the far side of the pool where [these two Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936559) are.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Luminous Pool Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509074). From [this chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936557), return to the path, face the way forward, but keep an eye out on the left for a side path through the bushes and under a thick tree root. This chest will be at the end of that side path.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Luminous Pool Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509074), at the base of the tree in the large lake room.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification during "[Beware of the Behemoth!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507478)".

**Location:** Inside the [Luminous Pool Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=509074). From [the previous chest](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=936568), head right into a side tunnel which has a few Esselings in it. This chest will be where the Esseling up on the high ledge on the right-hand wall. You'll need to use Gigantification to get up to it.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Ruins Near Elderwood Shade](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542614). In the first room at the bottom of the stairs, this will be on the shelves on your left, hidden behind smashable crates.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Ruins Near Elderwood Shade](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542614). Will be under the giant tree root growing through the first room at the bottom of the stairs.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Ruins Near Elderwood Shade](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542614). After smashing through the ground you'll emerge in a large waterlogged room with giant tree roots growing through it. Check under the tree root to find this on a ledge.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Acquire Gigantification during "[Beware of the Behemoth!](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=507478)".

**Location:** Inside the [Ruins Near Elderwood Shade](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542614). When you climb up the root with Blings on it at the start of the large waterlogged room, you'll come across a curved tunnel with a boulder at the end. Using Gigantification, push this builder, and it'll go around the bend and smash down a rock wall, revealing this chest.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Ruins Near Elderwood Shade](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542614). From the root where you actually collect the Whimstar, you can find this in the back-left corner, to the left of the hole in the wall to the next room.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Titan's Workshop Warehouse Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542612). From the northwestern entrance, you can find this in the back-right corner, up on the shelves and boxes.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Titan's Workshop Warehouse Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542612). At the cellar floor entrance, locate the nearby pot shelves with Esselings on the other side: slip under the shelves, defeat the Esselings, then look for this chest. It'll be on the left-hand wall, on top of a stack of two pots next to some shelves.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Titan's Workshop Warehouse Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542612). After going down the cellar stairs, check under the stairs to find this chest.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Titan's Workshop Warehouse Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=542612). This will be on a ledge overlooking the river in the cellar, which you can get to either by a red Blocking Fern, or using Gigantification, jumping then gliding.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Healing Ground North Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937566). From [the previous three Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937574), continue following the path around the bend to find this chest.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Healing Ground North Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937566). Will be on the ledge up on the back-right wall of the first big room, which you can reach using Dragonbones.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Healing Ground North Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937566). From [the previous three Dews](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937582), jump onto the rocky ledges above the Dragonbone Puzzle to find this.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** In the [Healing Ground North Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937566). After pushing the small boulders down the hill to open up a new tunnel, this will be at the top of the cliff you ascend using a trampoline.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Shore Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937568). In the same room as the previous three Dews, you can find this to the right of the dragon skull at the edge of the pool.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Shore Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=937568). From the previous chest, locate the nearby Zephyr Vent geyser and use it to get to an upper walkway. Head down it, then drop down to an area with two Dragonbones. Use them to make steps up the next rock wall, which has this chest at the top.

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

locations.title: Chest (Primary)

**Location:** On top of the big brass machine in the middle of the cheesecake factory. When coming here a second time, you can take a shortcut up by jumping on top of the Mechanical Arm on your right when you enter the factory. Infuse it with Motive Power to ride your way up!

**Challenge:** Complete the cake processing without missing 5 clusters of fruit.

locations.title: Quest
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** [All for You, Across a Millennium](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=933277)

**Location:** In the [Golden Court Back Door](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/miraland?locationIds=930642)'s Endless Night Court area, at the "start" of the curved "Thousand Mirrors Corridor" of broken mirrors.

**Challenge:** Clear the Thousand Mirrors Corridor level within 100s.
